texts.exo.16.23: And he said to them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To-morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath to the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to-day, and boil that ye will boil; and that which remaineth over, lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
texts.exo.16.24: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses ordered: and it did not putrefy, neither was there any worm therein.
texts.exo.16.25: And Moses said, Eat that to-day; for to-day is a sabbath to the LORD; to-day ye will not find it in the field.
texts.exo.16.26: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there will be none.
texts.exo.16.27: And it came to pass, that some of the people went out on the seventh day to gather, and they found none.
texts.exo.16.28: And the LORD said to Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
texts.exo.16.29: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days: abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
texts.exo.16.30: So the people rested on the seventh day.
texts.exo.16.31: And the house of Israel called its name Manna: and it was like coriander-seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
texts.exo.16.32: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
texts.exo.16.33: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
texts.exo.16.34: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
texts.exo.16.35: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited: they ate manna, until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
texts.exo.16.36: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
texts.exo.17.1: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and encamped in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
texts.exo.17.2: Wherefore the people contended with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said to them, Why chide you with me? why do ye tempt the LORD?
texts.exo.17.3: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Why is this that thou hast brought us out of Egypt to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
texts.exo.17.4: And Moses cried to the LORD, saying, What shall I do to this people? they are almost ready to stone me.
texts.exo.17.5: And the LORD said to Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel: and thy rod, with which thou smotest the river, take in thy hand, and go.
texts.exo.17.6: Behold, I will stand before thee there on the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and water shall come out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
texts.exo.17.7: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
texts.exo.17.8: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
texts.exo.17.9: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to-morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.
texts.exo.17.10: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur, went up to the top of the hill.
texts.exo.17.11: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
texts.exo.17.12: But Moses's hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat upon it: and Aaron and Hur supported his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
texts.exo.17.13: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
texts.exo.17.14: And the LORD said to Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
texts.exo.17.15: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it JEHOVAH-nissi:
texts.exo.17.16: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
texts.exo.18.1: When Jethro the priest of Midian, Moses's father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt:
texts.exo.18.2: Then Jethro, Moses's father-in-law, took Zipporah Moses's wife, after he had sent her back,
texts.exo.18.3: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; (for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:)
texts.exo.18.4: And the name of the other was Eliezer; (for the God of my father, said he, was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:)
texts.exo.18.5: And Jethro, Moses's father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
texts.exo.18.6: And he said to Moses, I thy father-in-law Jethro have come to thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
texts.exo.18.7: And Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and did obeisance, and kissed him: and they asked each other of their welfare: and they came into the tent.
texts.exo.18.8: And Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh, and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
texts.exo.18.9: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
texts.exo.18.10: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
texts.exo.18.11: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing in which they dealt proudly, he was above them.
texts.exo.18.12: And Jethro, Moses's father-in-law, took a burnt-offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses's father-in-law before God.
texts.exo.18.13: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning to the evening.
texts.exo.18.14: And when Moses's father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? Why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning to evening?
texts.exo.18.15: And Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to inquire of God:
texts.exo.18.16: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between one and another, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
texts.exo.18.17: And Moses's father-in-law said to him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
texts.exo.18.18: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
texts.exo.18.19: Hearken now to my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people toward God, that thou mayest bring the causes to God:
texts.exo.18.20: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.
texts.exo.18.21: Moreover, thou shalt provide out of all the people, able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
texts.exo.18.22: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring to thee, but every small matter they shall judge: So shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
texts.exo.18.23: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
texts.exo.18.24: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
texts.exo.18.25: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
texts.exo.18.26: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
texts.exo.18.27: And Moses let his father-in-law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
texts.exo.19.1: In the third month, when the children of Israel had gone forth from the land of Egypt, the same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.exo.19.2: For they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mount.
texts.exo.19.3: And Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
texts.exo.19.4: Ye have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself.
texts.exo.19.5: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure to me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
texts.exo.19.6: And ye shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak to the children of Israel.
texts.exo.19.7: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
texts.exo.19.8: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people to the LORD.
texts.exo.19.9: And the LORD said to Moses, Lo, I come to thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.
texts.exo.19.10: And the LORD said to Moses, Go to the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
texts.exo.19.11: And be ready against the third day: for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
texts.exo.19.12: And thou shalt set bounds to the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up upon the mount, or touch the border of it: whoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
texts.exo.19.13: There shall not a hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through: whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
texts.exo.19.14: And Moses went down from the mount to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
texts.exo.19.15: And he said to the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
texts.exo.19.16: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that were in the camp trembled.
texts.exo.19.17: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
texts.exo.19.18: And mount Sinai was altogether in a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke of it ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount trembled greatly.
texts.exo.19.19: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
texts.exo.19.20: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
texts.exo.19.21: And the LORD said to Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
texts.exo.19.22: And let the priests also who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
texts.exo.19.23: And Moses said to the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
texts.exo.19.24: And the LORD said to him, Away, go down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: But let not the priests and the people break through, to come up to the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
texts.exo.19.25: So Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.
texts.exo.20.1: And God spoke all these words, saying,
texts.exo.20.2: I am the LORD thy God, who have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
texts.exo.20.3: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
texts.exo.20.4: Thou shalt not make to thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
texts.exo.20.5: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
texts.exo.20.6: And showing mercy to thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
texts.exo.20.7: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
texts.exo.20.8: Remember the sabbath-day to keep it holy.
texts.exo.20.9: Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work:
texts.exo.20.10: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
texts.exo.20.11: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath-day, and hallowed it.
texts.exo.20.12: Honor thy father and thy mother; that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
texts.exo.20.16: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.
texts.exo.20.17: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife, nor his man-servant, nor his maid-servant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbor's.
texts.exo.20.18: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
texts.exo.20.19: And they said to Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
texts.exo.20.20: And Moses said to the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
texts.exo.20.21: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God was.
texts.exo.20.22: And the LORD said to Moses, Thus thou shalt say to the children of Israel; Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
texts.exo.20.23: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make to you gods of gold.
texts.exo.20.24: An altar of earth thou shalt make to me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt-offerings, and thy peace-offerings, thy sheep, and thy oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come to thee, and I will bless thee.
texts.exo.20.25: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou shalt lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
texts.exo.20.26: Neither shalt thou go up by steps to my altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
texts.exo.21.1: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
texts.exo.21.2: If thou shalt buy a Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall depart free for nothing.
texts.exo.21.3: If he came in by himself, he shall depart by himself: if he was married, then his wife shall depart with him.
texts.exo.21.4: If his master hath given him a wife, and she hath borne him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall depart by himself.
texts.exo.21.5: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not depart free:
texts.exo.21.6: Then his master shall bring him to the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or to the door-post: and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall serve him for ever.
texts.exo.21.7: And if a man shall sell his daughter to be a maid-servant, she shall not depart as the men-servants do.
texts.exo.21.8: If she shall not please her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her to a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
texts.exo.21.9: And if he hath betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
texts.exo.21.10: If he shall take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage shall he not diminish.
texts.exo.21.11: And if he shall not perform these three to her, then shall she depart free without money.
texts.exo.21.12: He that smiteth a man, so that he dieth, shall be surely put to death.
texts.exo.21.13: And if a man shall not lie in wait, but God shall deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
texts.exo.21.14: But if a man shall come presumptuously upon his neighbor, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from my altar, that he may die.
texts.exo.21.15: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
texts.exo.21.16: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he shall be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
texts.exo.21.17: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
texts.exo.21.18: And if men contend together, and one shall smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he shall not die, but keep his bed:
texts.exo.21.19: If he shall rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
texts.exo.21.20: And if a man shall smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he shall die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
texts.exo.21.21: Notwithstanding, if he shall continue a day or two, he shall not be punished; for he is his money.
texts.exo.21.22: If men shall contend, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit shall depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
texts.exo.21.23: And if any mischief shall follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
texts.exo.21.24: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
texts.exo.21.25: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
texts.exo.21.26: And if a man shall smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it shall perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
texts.exo.21.27: And if he shall smite out his man-servant's tooth, or his maid-servant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
texts.exo.21.28: If an ox shall gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
texts.exo.21.29: But if the ox was accustomed to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not restrained him, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
texts.exo.21.30: If there shall be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatever is laid upon him.
texts.exo.21.31: Whether he hath gored a son, or hath gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done to him.
texts.exo.21.32: If the ox shall push a man-servant, or maid-servant; he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
texts.exo.21.33: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass shall fall into it;
texts.exo.21.34: The owner of the pit shall make compensation, and give money to the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
texts.exo.21.35: And if one man's ox shall hurt another's that he shall die, then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it, and the dead ox also they shall divide.
texts.exo.21.36: Or if it shall be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not restrained him; he shall surely pay ox for ox, and the dead shall be his own.
texts.exo.22.1: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
texts.exo.22.2: If a thief shall be found breaking through, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
texts.exo.22.3: If the sun shall have risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him: for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
texts.exo.22.4: If the theft shall be certainly found in his hand alive, whether an ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
texts.exo.22.5: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field: of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard shall he make restitution.
texts.exo.22.6: If fire shall break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field shall be consumed; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
texts.exo.22.7: If a man shall deliver to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief shall be found, let him pay double.
texts.exo.22.8: If the thief shall not be found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges, to see whether he hath put his hand to his neighbor's goods.
texts.exo.22.9: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another challengeth to be his: the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and he whom the judges shall condemn, shall pay double to his neighbor.
texts.exo.22.10: If a man shall deliver to his neighbor an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast to keep; and it shall die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
texts.exo.22.11: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand to his neighbor's goods; and the owner of it shall accept of it, and he shall not make restitution.
texts.exo.22.12: And if it shall be stolen from him, he shall make restitution to the owner of it.
texts.exo.22.13: If it shall be torn in pieces; then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
texts.exo.22.14: And if a man shall borrow aught of his neighbor, and it shall be hurt, or die, the owner of it being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
texts.exo.22.15: But if the owner of it shall be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be a hired thing, it came for his hire.
texts.exo.22.16: And if a man shall entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
texts.exo.22.17: If her father shall utterly refuse to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dower of virgins.
texts.exo.22.18: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
texts.exo.22.19: Whoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
texts.exo.22.20: He that sacrificeth to any god, save to the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
texts.exo.22.21: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
texts.exo.22.22: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
texts.exo.22.23: If thou shalt afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry:
texts.exo.22.24: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
texts.exo.22.25: If thou shalt lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as a usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
texts.exo.22.26: If thou shalt at all take thy neighbor's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it to him by the setting of the sun.
texts.exo.22.27: For that is his only covering, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth to me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
texts.exo.22.28: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
texts.exo.22.29: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the first-born of thy sons shalt thou give to me.
texts.exo.22.30: Likewise shalt thou do with thy oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it to me.
texts.exo.22.31: And ye shall be holy men to me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
texts.exo.23.1: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thy hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
texts.exo.23.2: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
texts.exo.23.3: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
texts.exo.23.4: If thou shalt meet thy enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
texts.exo.23.5: If thou shalt see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
texts.exo.23.6: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
texts.exo.23.7: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
texts.exo.23.8: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
texts.exo.23.9: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger; for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
texts.exo.23.10: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
texts.exo.23.11: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave, the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy olive-yard.
texts.exo.23.12: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thy ox and thy ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
texts.exo.23.13: And in all things that I have said to you be circumspect: and make no mention of the names of other gods, neither let it be heard from thy mouth.
texts.exo.23.14: Three times thou shalt keep a feast to me in the year.
texts.exo.23.15: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
texts.exo.23.16: And the feast of harvest, the first-fruits of thy labors, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of in-gathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labors out of the field.
texts.exo.23.17: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
texts.exo.23.18: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
texts.exo.23.19: The first of the first-fruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
texts.exo.23.20: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
texts.exo.23.21: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
texts.exo.23.22: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and an adversary to thy adversaries.
texts.exo.23.23: For my Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in to the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I will cut them off.
texts.exo.23.24: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
texts.exo.23.25: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
texts.exo.23.26: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: I will complete the number of thy days.
texts.exo.23.27: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thy enemies turn their backs to thee.
texts.exo.23.28: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before thee.
texts.exo.23.29: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land should become desolate, and the beast of the field should multiply against thee.
texts.exo.23.30: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou shalt be increased and inherit the land.
texts.exo.23.31: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
texts.exo.23.32: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
texts.exo.23.33: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee to sin against me: for if thou shalt serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to thee.
texts.exo.24.1: And he said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
texts.exo.24.2: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
texts.exo.24.3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we perform.
texts.exo.24.4: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose early in the morning, and built an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
texts.exo.24.5: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings of oxen to the LORD.
texts.exo.24.6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
texts.exo.24.7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
texts.exo.24.8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold, the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
texts.exo.24.9: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
texts.exo.24.10: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire-stone, and as it were the body of heaven in its clearness.
texts.exo.24.11: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and ate and drank.
texts.exo.24.12: And the LORD said to Moses, Come up to me on the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayst teach them.
texts.exo.24.13: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up upon the mount of God.
texts.exo.24.14: And he said to the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again to you: and behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man hath any matters to do, let him come to them.
texts.exo.24.15: And Moses went up upon the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
texts.exo.24.16: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.
texts.exo.24.17: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount, in the eyes of the children of Israel.
texts.exo.24.18: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and ascended the mount: and Moses was on the mount forty days and forty nights.
texts.exo.25.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.25.2: Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
texts.exo.25.3: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver and brass,
texts.exo.25.4: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair.
texts.exo.25.5: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood.
texts.exo.25.6: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
texts.exo.25.7: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breast-plate.
texts.exo.25.8: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
texts.exo.25.9: According to all that I show thee after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all its instruments, even so shall ye make it.
texts.exo.25.10: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its hight.
texts.exo.25.11: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold around it.
texts.exo.25.12: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
texts.exo.25.13: And thou shalt make staffs of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
texts.exo.25.14: And thou shalt put the staffs into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
texts.exo.25.15: The staffs shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
texts.exo.25.16: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
texts.exo.25.17: And thou shalt make a mercy-seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
texts.exo.25.18: And thou shalt make two cherubim of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy-seat.
texts.exo.25.19: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy-seat shall ye make the cherubim on its two ends.
texts.exo.25.20: And the cherubim shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; towards the mercy-seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
texts.exo.25.21: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
texts.exo.25.22: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy-seat, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment to the children of Israel.
texts.exo.25.23: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: its length shall be two cubits, and its breadth a cubit, and its hight a cubit and a half.
texts.exo.25.24: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make to it a crown of gold around it.
texts.exo.25.25: And thou shalt make to it a border of an hand-breadth around it, and thou shalt make a golden crown to its border around it.
texts.exo.25.26: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
texts.exo.25.27: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staffs to bear the table.
texts.exo.25.28: And thou shalt make the staffs of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
texts.exo.25.29: And thou shalt make its dishes, and its spoons, and its covers, and its bowls, to cover it with: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
texts.exo.25.30: And thou shalt set upon the table show-bread before me always.
texts.exo.25.31: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: its shaft, and its branches, its bowls, its knobs, and its flowers, shall be of the same.
texts.exo.25.32: And six branches shall extend from the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick from the one side, and three branches of the candlestick from the other side:
texts.exo.25.33: Three bowls made like to almonds, with a knob and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knob and a flower: so in the six branches that project from the candlestick.
texts.exo.25.34: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like to almonds, with their knobs and their flowers.
texts.exo.25.35: And there shall be a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that project from the candlestick.
texts.exo.25.36: Their knobs and their branches shall be of the same: all of it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
texts.exo.25.37: And thou shalt make its seven lamps: and they shall light its lamps, that they may give light over against it.
texts.exo.25.38: And its tongs, and its snuff-dishes, shall be of pure gold.
texts.exo.25.39: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
texts.exo.25.40: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shown thee on the mount.
texts.exo.26.1: Moreover, thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubim of curious work shalt thou make them.
texts.exo.26.2: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
texts.exo.26.3: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
texts.exo.26.4: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
texts.exo.26.5: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
texts.exo.26.6: And thou shalt make fifty buttons of gold, and couple the curtains together with the buttons: and it shall be one tabernacle.
texts.exo.26.7: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
texts.exo.26.8: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
texts.exo.26.9: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the front of the tabernacle.
texts.exo.26.10: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
texts.exo.26.11: And thou shalt make fifty buttons of brass, and put the buttons into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
texts.exo.26.12: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
texts.exo.26.13: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
texts.exo.26.14: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent, of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
texts.exo.26.15: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
texts.exo.26.16: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
texts.exo.26.17: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
texts.exo.26.18: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
texts.exo.26.19: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
texts.exo.26.20: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
texts.exo.26.21: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
texts.exo.26.22: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
texts.exo.26.23: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
texts.exo.26.24: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
texts.exo.26.25: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
texts.exo.26.26: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
texts.exo.26.27: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
texts.exo.26.28: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
texts.exo.26.29: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars; and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
texts.exo.26.30: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shown thee on the mount.
texts.exo.26.31: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of curious work: with cherubim shall it be made.
texts.exo.26.32: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
texts.exo.26.33: And thou shalt hang the vail under the buttons, that thou mayst bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide to you between the holy place and the most holy.
texts.exo.26.34: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat upon the ark of the testimony, in the most holy place.
texts.exo.26.35: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle towards the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
texts.exo.26.36: And thou shalt make a hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needle work.
texts.exo.26.37: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
texts.exo.27.1: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and its hight shall be three cubits.
texts.exo.27.2: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: its horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
texts.exo.27.3: And thou shalt make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pans: all its vessels thou shalt make of brass.
texts.exo.27.4: And thou shalt make for it a grate of net-work of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brazen rings in its four corners.
texts.exo.27.5: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
texts.exo.27.6: And thou shalt make staffs for the altar, staffs of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
texts.exo.27.7: And the staffs shall be put into the rings, and the staffs shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
texts.exo.27.8: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shown thee on the mount, so shall they make it.
texts.exo.27.9: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of a hundred cubits long for one side:
texts.exo.27.10: And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets shall be of brass: the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
texts.exo.27.11: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of a hundred cubits long, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass: the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
texts.exo.27.12: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
texts.exo.27.13: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
texts.exo.27.14: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
texts.exo.27.15: And on the other side shall be hangings, fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
texts.exo.27.16: And for the gate of the court shall be a hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needle-work: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
texts.exo.27.17: All the pillars around the court shall be filleted with silver: their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
texts.exo.27.18: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the hight five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
texts.exo.27.19: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
texts.exo.27.20: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring the pure olive-oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
texts.exo.27.21: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: It shall be a statute for ever to their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
texts.exo.28.1: And take thou to thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
texts.exo.28.2: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for glory and for beauty.
texts.exo.28.3: And thou shalt speak to all that are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.
texts.exo.28.4: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breast-plate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a miter, and a girdle; and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.
texts.exo.28.5: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
texts.exo.28.6: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with curious work.
texts.exo.28.7: It shall have the two shoulder-pieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
texts.exo.28.8: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to its work; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
texts.exo.28.9: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel:
texts.exo.28.10: Six of their names on one stone, and the six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
texts.exo.28.11: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
texts.exo.28.12: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial to the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
texts.exo.28.13: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
texts.exo.28.14: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathed work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathed chains to the ouches.
texts.exo.28.15: And thou shalt make the breast-plate of judgment with curious work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen shalt thou make it.
texts.exo.28.16: Foursquare it shall be, being doubled; a span shall be its length, and a span shall be its breadth.
texts.exo.28.17: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
texts.exo.28.18: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
texts.exo.28.19: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
texts.exo.28.20: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
texts.exo.28.21: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
texts.exo.28.22: And thou shalt make upon the breast-plate chains at the ends of wreathed work of pure gold.
texts.exo.28.23: And thou shalt make upon the breast-plate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breast-plate.
texts.exo.28.24: And thou shalt put the two wreathed chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breast-plate.
texts.exo.28.25: And the other two ends of the two wreathed chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod before it.
texts.exo.28.26: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breast-plate in its border, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
texts.exo.28.27: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, towards the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
texts.exo.28.28: And they shall bind the breast-plate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breast-plate be not loosed from the ephod.
texts.exo.28.29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breast-plate of judgment upon his heart, when he entereth into the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
texts.exo.28.30: And thou shalt put in the breast-plate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
texts.exo.28.31: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
texts.exo.28.32: And there shall be a hole in the top of it, in the midst of it: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
texts.exo.28.33: And beneath, upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about its hem; and bells of gold between them around it.
texts.exo.28.34: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe around it.
texts.exo.28.35: And it shall be upon Aaron, to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out; that he may not die.
texts.exo.28.36: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and engrave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
texts.exo.28.37: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the miter; upon the front of the miter it shall be.
texts.exo.28.38: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
texts.exo.28.39: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the miter of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needle-work.
texts.exo.28.40: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
texts.exo.28.41: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and on his sons with him: and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.
texts.exo.28.42: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness: from the loins even to the thighs they shall reach:
texts.exo.28.43: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they enter in to the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die. It shall be a statute for ever to him, and to his seed after him.
texts.exo.29.1: And this is the thing that thou shalt do to them to hallow them, to minister to me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
texts.exo.29.2: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil; of wheat flour shalt thou make them.
texts.exo.29.3: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
texts.exo.29.4: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
texts.exo.29.5: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron, the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breast-plate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
texts.exo.29.6: And thou shalt put the miter upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the miter.
texts.exo.29.7: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
texts.exo.29.8: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
texts.exo.29.9: And thou shalt gird them with girdles (Aaron and his sons) and put the bonnets on them; and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
texts.exo.29.10: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
texts.exo.29.11: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.exo.29.12: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
texts.exo.29.13: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
texts.exo.29.14: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin-offering.
texts.exo.29.15: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
texts.exo.29.16: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it around upon the altar.
texts.exo.29.17: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them to his pieces, and to his head.
texts.exo.29.18: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering to the LORD: it is a sweet savor, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
texts.exo.29.19: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
texts.exo.29.20: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
texts.exo.29.21: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons garments with him.
texts.exo.29.22: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
texts.exo.29.23: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread, that is before the LORD.
texts.exo.29.24: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD.
texts.exo.29.25: And thou shalt receive them from their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt-offering, for a sweet savor before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
texts.exo.29.26: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave-offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
texts.exo.29.27: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the heave-offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
texts.exo.29.28: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever, from the children of Israel: for it is a heave-offering: and it shall be a heave-offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace-offerings, even their heave-offering to the LORD.
texts.exo.29.29: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
texts.exo.29.30: And that son, that is priest in his stead, shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
texts.exo.29.31: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
texts.exo.29.32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.exo.29.33: And they shall eat those things with which the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat of them, because they are holy.
texts.exo.29.34: And if aught of the flesh of the consecration, or of the bread, shall remain till the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
texts.exo.29.35: And thus shalt thou do to Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
texts.exo.29.36: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin-offering for atonement; and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
texts.exo.29.37: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
texts.exo.29.38: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year, day by day continually.
texts.exo.29.39: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at evening.
texts.exo.29.40: And with the one lamb a tenth-portion of flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink-offering.
texts.exo.29.41: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at evening, and shalt do thereto according to the meat-offering of the morning, and according to the drink-offering thereof, for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
texts.exo.29.42: This shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you to speak there to thee.
texts.exo.29.43: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
texts.exo.29.44: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
texts.exo.29.45: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
texts.exo.29.46: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
texts.exo.30.1: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
texts.exo.30.2: A cubit shall be its length, and a cubit its breadth; foursquare shall it be; and two cubits shall be its hight: its horns shall be of the same.
texts.exo.30.3: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, its top, and its sides round about, and its horns; and thou shalt make to it a crown of gold round about.
texts.exo.30.4: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by its two corners, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staffs to bear it with.
texts.exo.30.5: And thou shalt make the staffs of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
texts.exo.30.6: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy-seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
texts.exo.30.7: And Aaron shall burn upon it sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
texts.exo.30.8: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at evening, he shall burn incense upon it; a perpetual incense before the LORD, throughout your generations.
texts.exo.30.9: Ye shall offer no strange incense upon it, nor burnt-sacrifice, nor meat-offering; neither shall ye pour drink-offering upon it.
texts.exo.30.10: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year, with the blood of the sin-offering of atonements: once in a year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy to the LORD.
texts.exo.30.11: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.12: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to the LORD, when thou numberest them: that there may be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
texts.exo.30.13: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) a half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
texts.exo.30.14: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering to the LORD.
texts.exo.30.15: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering to the LORD to make an atonement for your souls.
texts.exo.30.16: And thou shalt take the atonement-money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial to the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
texts.exo.30.17: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.18: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and its foot also of brass, to wash in: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
texts.exo.30.19: For Aaron and their sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
texts.exo.30.20: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not: or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire to the LORD.
texts.exo.30.21: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
texts.exo.30.22: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.23: Take thou also to thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
texts.exo.30.24: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive-oil a hin:
texts.exo.30.25: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
texts.exo.30.26: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation with it, and the ark of the testimony,
texts.exo.30.27: And the table and all its vessels, and the candlestick and its vessels, and the altar of incense,
texts.exo.30.28: And the altar of burnt-offering with all its vessels, and the laver and its foot.
texts.exo.30.29: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatever toucheth them shall be holy.
texts.exo.30.30: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.
texts.exo.30.31: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil to me, throughout your generations.
texts.exo.30.32: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.
texts.exo.30.33: Whoever compoundeth any like it, or whoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
texts.exo.30.34: And the LORD said to Moses, Take to thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
texts.exo.30.35: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
texts.exo.30.36: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be to you most holy:
texts.exo.30.37: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to its composition: it shall be to thee holy for the LORD.
texts.exo.30.38: Whoever shall make the like to that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
texts.exo.31.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.31.2: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
texts.exo.31.3: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
texts.exo.31.4: To devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
texts.exo.31.5: And in cutting of stones to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
texts.exo.31.6: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all that are wise-hearted I have put wisdom; that they may make all that I have commanded thee:
texts.exo.31.7: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy-seat that is upon it, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
texts.exo.31.8: And the table and its furniture, and the pure candlestick with all its furniture, and the altar of incense,
texts.exo.31.9: And the altar of burnt-offering, with all its furniture, and the laver and its foot,
texts.exo.31.10: And the clothes of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
texts.exo.31.11: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee, shall they do.
texts.exo.31.12: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.31.13: Speak thou also to the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
texts.exo.31.14: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore: for it is holy to you. Every one that profaneth it shall surely be put to death: for whoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
texts.exo.31.15: Six days may work be done, but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whoever doeth any work in the sabbath-day, he shall surely be put to death.
texts.exo.31.16: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
texts.exo.31.17: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.
texts.exo.31.18: And to Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, he gave two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
texts.exo.32.1: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mount, the people assembled themselves to Aaron, and said to him, Arise, make us gods which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
texts.exo.32.2: And Aaron said to them, Break off the golden ear-rings which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.
texts.exo.32.3: And all the people broke off the golden ear-rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
texts.exo.32.4: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt.
texts.exo.32.5: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To-morrow is a feast to the LORD.
texts.exo.32.6: And they rose early on the morrow, and offered burnt-offerings, and brought peace-offerings: and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
texts.exo.32.7: And the LORD said to Moses, Go, go down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
texts.exo.32.8: They have turned aside quickly from the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt.
texts.exo.32.9: And the LORD said to Moses, I have seen this people, and behold it is a stiff-necked people:
texts.exo.32.10: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
texts.exo.32.11: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why [] thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast [] forth from the land of Egypt, with great power, and with [] mighty hand?
texts.exo.32.12: Why should the Egyptians speak and say, For evil did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
texts.exo.32.13: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel thy servants, to whom thou sworest by thine own self, and saidst to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give to your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
texts.exo.32.14: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do to his people.
texts.exo.32.15: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
texts.exo.32.16: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
texts.exo.32.17: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
texts.exo.32.18: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
texts.exo.32.19: And it came to pass as soon as he came nigh to the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses's anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables from his hands, and broke them beneath the mount.
texts.exo.32.20: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strewed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
texts.exo.32.21: And Moses said to Aaron, What did this people to thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
texts.exo.32.22: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people that they are set on mischief.
texts.exo.32.23: For they said to me, Make us gods which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
texts.exo.32.24: And I said to them, Whoever hath any gold, let them break it off: So they gave it to me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
texts.exo.32.25: And when Moses saw that the people were naked (for Aaron had made them naked to their shame, among their enemies:)
texts.exo.32.26: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S side? let him come to me. And all the sons of Levi assembled themselves to him.
texts.exo.32.27: And he said to them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.
texts.exo.32.28: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
texts.exo.32.29: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to-day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
texts.exo.32.30: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up to the LORD; it may be I shall make an atonement for your sin.
texts.exo.32.31: And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
texts.exo.32.32: Yet now, if thou wilt, forgive their sin: and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
texts.exo.32.33: And the LORD said to Moses, Whoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
texts.exo.32.34: Therefore now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to thee: Behold, my angel shall go before thee: Nevertheless, in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them.
texts.exo.32.35: And the LORD afflicted the people, because they made the calf which Aaron made.
texts.exo.33.1: And the LORD said to Moses, Depart and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast conducted from the land of Egypt, to the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, to thy seed will I give it:
texts.exo.33.2: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
texts.exo.33.3: To a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiff-necked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
texts.exo.33.4: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man put on him his ornaments.
texts.exo.33.5: For the LORD had said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, Ye are a stiff-necked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do to thee.
texts.exo.33.6: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments, by the mount Horeb.
texts.exo.33.7: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp far from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one who sought the LORD, went out to the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
texts.exo.33.8: And it came to pass when Moses went out to the tabernacle, that all the people rose, and stood every man at his tent-door, and looked after Moses, until he had gone into the tabernacle.
texts.exo.33.9: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.
texts.exo.33.10: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose and worshiped, every man in his tent-door.
texts.exo.33.11: And the LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaketh to his friend. And he turned again into the camp; but his servant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
texts.exo.33.12: And Moses said to the LORD, See, thou sayest to me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
texts.exo.33.13: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, show me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
texts.exo.33.14: And he said, My presence shall attend thee, and I will give thee rest.
texts.exo.33.15: And he said to him, If thy presence shall not attend me, conduct us not hence.
texts.exo.33.16: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? Is it not in that thou goest with us? So shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
texts.exo.33.17: And the LORD said to Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
