texts.exo.28.37: And thou shalt put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be upon the turban -- upon the front of the turban shall it be.
texts.exo.28.38: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all gifts of their holy things; and it shall be continually on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.
texts.exo.28.39: And thou shalt weave the vest of byssus; and thou shalt make a turban of byssus; and thou shalt make a girdle of embroidery.
texts.exo.28.40: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make vests; and thou shalt make for them girdles; and high caps shalt thou make for them, for glory and for ornament.
texts.exo.28.41: And thou shalt clothe with them Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and hallow them, that they may serve me as priests.
texts.exo.28.42: And thou shalt make them linen trousers to cover the flesh of nakedness; from the loins even to the hips shall they reach.
texts.exo.28.43: And they shall be upon Aaron and his sons when they enter into the tent of meeting, or when they come near to the altar to serve in the sanctuary; that they may not bear iniquity and die -- an everlasting statute for him and his seed after him.
texts.exo.29.1: And this is the thing which thou shalt do to them to hallow them, that they may serve me as priests: take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
texts.exo.29.2: and unleavened bread, and unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil -- of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
texts.exo.29.3: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and present them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
texts.exo.29.4: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring near the entrance of the tent of meeting, and shalt bathe them with water.
texts.exo.29.5: And thou shalt take the garments, and clothe Aaron with the vest, and the cloak of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and shalt gird him with the girdle of the ephod.
texts.exo.29.6: And thou shalt put the turban upon his head, and fasten the holy diadem to the turban,
texts.exo.29.7: and shalt take the anointing oil, and pour [it] on his head, and anoint him.
texts.exo.29.8: And thou shalt bring his sons near, and clothe them with the vests.
texts.exo.29.9: And thou shalt gird them with the girdle -- Aaron and his sons, and bind the high caps on them; and the priesthood shall be theirs for an everlasting statute; and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
texts.exo.29.10: And thou shalt present the bullock before the tent of meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock;
texts.exo.29.11: and thou shalt slaughter the bullock before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting;
texts.exo.29.12: and thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it on the horns of the altar with thy finger, and shalt pour all the blood at the bottom of the altar.
texts.exo.29.13: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the net of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
texts.exo.29.14: And the flesh of the bullock, and its skin, and its dung, shalt thou burn with fire outside the camp: it is a sin-offering.
texts.exo.29.15: And thou shalt take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram;
texts.exo.29.16: and thou shalt slaughter the ram, and shalt take its blood, and sprinkle [it] on the altar round about.
texts.exo.29.17: And thou shalt cut up the ram into its pieces, and wash its inwards, and its legs, and put [them] upon its pieces, and upon its head;
texts.exo.29.18: and thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering to Jehovah -- a sweet odour; it is an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.19: And thou shalt take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram;
texts.exo.29.20: and thou shalt slaughter the ram, and take of its blood, and put [it] on the tip of the [right] ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and thou shalt sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
texts.exo.29.21: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle [it] on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him; and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
texts.exo.29.22: Also of the ram shalt thou take the fat, and the fat-tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the net of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder -- for it is a ram of consecration --
texts.exo.29.23: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened [bread] that is before Jehovah;
texts.exo.29.24: and thou shalt put all this in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons, and shalt wave them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.25: And thou shalt receive them of their hand and burn [them] upon the altar over the burnt-offering, for a sweet odour before Jehovah: it is an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.26: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of consecration which is for Aaron, and wave it as a wave-offering before Jehovah; and it shall be thy part.
texts.exo.29.27: And thou shalt hallow the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the heave-offering, that hath been waved and heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, of that which is for Aaron, and of [that] which is for his sons.
texts.exo.29.28: And they shall be for Aaron and his sons, as an everlasting statute, on the part of the children of Israel; for it is a heave-offering; and it shall be a heave-offering on the part of the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, [as] their heave-offering to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.29: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
texts.exo.29.30: The son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tent of meeting to serve in the sanctuary.
texts.exo.29.31: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and boil its flesh in a holy place.
texts.exo.29.32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
texts.exo.29.33: They shall eat the things with which the atonement was made, to consecrate [and] to hallow them; but a stranger shall not eat [of them], for they are holy.
texts.exo.29.34: And if [any] of the flesh of the consecration, and of the bread, remain until the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, for it is holy.
texts.exo.29.35: And thus shalt thou do to Aaron, and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
texts.exo.29.36: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock as a sin-offering for atonement; and the altar shalt thou cleanse from sin, by making atonement for it, and shalt anoint it, to hallow it.
texts.exo.29.37: Seven days shalt thou make atonement for the altar and hallow it; and the altar shall be most holy: whatever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
texts.exo.29.38: And this is what thou shalt offer upon the altar -- two lambs of the first year, day by day continually.
texts.exo.29.39: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings.
texts.exo.29.40: And with the one lamb a tenth part of wheaten flour mingled with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin; and a drink-offering, a fourth part of a hin of wine.
texts.exo.29.41: And the second lamb shalt thou offer between the two evenings; as the oblation in the morning, and as its drink-offering shalt thou offer with this, for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.42: It shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah, where I will meet with you, to speak there with thee.
texts.exo.29.43: And there will I meet with the children of Israel; and it shall be hallowed by my glory.
texts.exo.29.44: And I will hallow the tent of meeting, and the altar; and I will hallow Aaron and his sons, that they may serve me as priests.
texts.exo.29.45: And I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel, and will be their God.
texts.exo.29.46: And they shall know that I am Jehovah their God, who have brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, to dwell in their midst: I am Jehovah their God.
texts.exo.30.1: And thou shalt make an altar for the burning of incense: of acacia-wood shalt thou make it;
texts.exo.30.2: a cubit the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof -- square shall it be; and two cubits its height; of itself shall be its horns.
texts.exo.30.3: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make upon it a border of gold round about.
texts.exo.30.4: And two rings of gold shalt thou make for it under its border; by its two corners shalt thou make [them], on the two sides thereof; and they shall be for receptacles for the staves, with which to carry it.
texts.exo.30.5: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold.
texts.exo.30.6: And thou shalt put it in front of the veil which is before the ark of the testimony in front of the mercy-seat which is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
texts.exo.30.7: And Aaron shall burn thereon fragrant incense: every morning, when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn the incense.
texts.exo.30.8: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps between the two evenings, he shall burn the incense -- a continual incense before Jehovah throughout your generations.
texts.exo.30.9: Ye shall offer up no strange incense thereon, nor burnt-offering, nor oblation; neither shall ye pour drink-offering thereon.
texts.exo.30.10: And Aaron shall make atonement for its horns once in the year: with the blood of the sin-offering of atonement shall he make atonement for it, once in the year, throughout your generations: it is most holy to Jehovah.
texts.exo.30.11: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.12: When thou shalt take the sum of the children of Israel according to those of them that are numbered, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to Jehovah on their being numbered, that there be no plague among them on their being numbered.
texts.exo.30.13: This shall they give -- every one that passeth among them that are numbered -- half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary, -- twenty gerahs the shekel; a half shekel shall be the heave-offering for Jehovah.
texts.exo.30.14: Every one that passeth among those that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give the heave-offering of Jehovah.
texts.exo.30.15: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when ye give the heave-offering of Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.
texts.exo.30.16: And thou shalt take the atonement-money of the children of Israel, and devote it to the service of the tent of meeting; and it shall be a memorial to the children of Israel before Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.
texts.exo.30.17: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.18: Thou shalt also make a laver of copper, and its stand of copper, for washing; and thou shalt put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water in it.
texts.exo.30.19: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet out of it.
texts.exo.30.20: When they go into the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, that they may not die; or when they come near to the altar to serve, to burn an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.exo.30.21: And they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they may not die; and it shall be an everlasting statute for them, for him and for his seed throughout their generations.
texts.exo.30.22: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.23: And thou, take best spices -- of liquid myrrh five hundred [shekels], and of sweet cinnamon the half -- two hundred and fifty, and of sweet myrtle two hundred and fifty,
texts.exo.30.24: and of cassia five hundred, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin;
texts.exo.30.25: and make of it an oil of holy ointment, a perfume of perfumery after the work of the perfumer: it shall be the holy anointing oil.
texts.exo.30.26: And thou shalt anoint the tent of meeting with it, and the ark of the testimony,
texts.exo.30.27: and the table and all its utensils, and the lamp-stand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,
texts.exo.30.28: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its utensils, and the laver and its stand.
texts.exo.30.29: And thou shalt hallow them, that they may be most holy: whatever toucheth them shall be holy.
texts.exo.30.30: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt anoint, and shalt hallow them, that they may serve me as priests.
texts.exo.30.31: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, A holy anointing oil shall this be unto me throughout your generations.
texts.exo.30.32: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make [any] like it, after the preparation of it: it is holy -- holy shall it be unto you.
texts.exo.30.33: Whoever compoundeth [any] like it, or whoever putteth [any] of it upon any strange thing, shall be cut off from his peoples.
texts.exo.30.34: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take fragrant drugs -- stacte, and onycha, and galbanum -- fragrant drugs and pure frankincense; in like proportions shall it be.
texts.exo.30.35: And thou shalt make it into incense, a perfume, after the work of the perfumer, salted, pure, holy.
texts.exo.30.36: And thou shalt beat [some] of it to powder, and put [some] of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
texts.exo.30.37: And the incense that thou shalt make, ye shall not make for yourselves according to the proportions of it; it shall be unto thee holy to Jehovah.
texts.exo.30.38: Whoever maketh like unto it, to smell it, shall be cut off from his peoples.
texts.exo.31.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.31.2: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
texts.exo.31.3: and have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in every work,
texts.exo.31.4: to devise artistic work -- to work in gold, and in silver, and in copper,
texts.exo.31.5: and in cutting of stones, for setting, and for carving of timber -- to work in all manner of work.
texts.exo.31.6: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of every one that is wise-hearted have I given wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee --
texts.exo.31.7: the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy-seat that is thereupon, and all the utensils of the tent,
texts.exo.31.8: and the table and its utensils, and the pure lamp-stand and all its utensils, and the altar of incense;
texts.exo.31.9: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its utensils, and the laver and its stand;
texts.exo.31.10: and the garments of service, both the holy garments of Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests;
texts.exo.31.11: and the anointing oil, and the incense of fragrant drugs for the sanctuary: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
texts.exo.31.12: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.31.13: And thou, speak thou unto the children of Israel, saying, Surely my sabbaths shall ye keep; for this is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that ye may know that it is I, Jehovah, who do hallow you.
texts.exo.31.14: Keep the sabbath, therefore; for it is holy unto you; every one that profaneth it shall certainly be put to death: yea, whoever doeth work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his peoples.
texts.exo.31.15: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, holy to Jehovah: whoever doeth work on the sabbath day shall certainly be put to death.
texts.exo.31.16: And the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations -- [it is] an everlasting covenant.
texts.exo.31.17: It shall be a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever; for [in] six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
texts.exo.31.18: And he gave to Moses, when he had ended speaking with him on mount Sinai, the two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
texts.exo.32.1: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people collected together to Aaron, and said to him, Up, make us a god, who will go before us; for this Moses, the man that has brought us up out of the land of Egypt, -- we do not know what is become of him!
texts.exo.32.2: And Aaron said to them, Break off the golden rings that are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring [them] to me.
texts.exo.32.3: Then all the people broke off the golden rings that were in their ears, and brought [them] to Aaron.
texts.exo.32.4: And he took [them] out of their hand, and fashioned it with a chisel and made of it a molten calf: and they said, This is thy god, Israel, who has brought thee up out of the land of Egypt!
texts.exo.32.5: And Aaron saw [it], and built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, To-morrow is a feast to Jehovah!
texts.exo.32.6: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered up burnt-offerings, and brought peace-offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to sport.
texts.exo.32.7: Then Jehovah said to Moses, Away, go down! for thy people, which thou hast brought out of the land of Egypt, is acting corruptly.
texts.exo.32.8: They have turned aside quickly out of the way that I commanded them: they have made themselves a molten calf, and have bowed down to it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, This is thy god, Israel, who has brought thee up out of the land of Egypt!
texts.exo.32.9: And Jehovah said to Moses, I see this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.
texts.exo.32.10: And now let me alone, that my anger may burn against them, and I may consume them; and I will make of thee a great nation.
texts.exo.32.11: And Moses besought Jehovah his God, and said, Why, Jehovah, doth thy wrath burn against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?
texts.exo.32.12: Why should the Egyptians speak, and say, For misfortune he has brought them out, to slay them on the mountains, and to annihilate them from the face of the earth? Turn from the heat of thine anger, and repent of this evil against thy people!
texts.exo.32.13: Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou sworest by thyself, and saidst to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give to your seed, and they shall possess [it] for ever!
texts.exo.32.14: And Jehovah repented of the evil that he had said he would do to his people.
texts.exo.32.15: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, [with] the two tables of the testimony in his hand -- tables written on both their sides: on this side and on that were they written.
texts.exo.32.16: And the tables [were] God's work, and the writing was God's writing, engraven on the tables.
texts.exo.32.17: And Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, and said to Moses, There is a shout of war in the camp.
texts.exo.32.18: And he said, It is not the sound of a shout of victory, neither is it the sound of a shout of defeat: it is the noise of alternate singing I hear.
texts.exo.32.19: And it came to pass, when he came near the camp, and saw the calf and the dancing, that Moses' anger burned, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and shattered them beneath the mountain.
texts.exo.32.20: And he took the calf that they had made, and burned [it] with fire, and ground it to powder, and strewed [it] on the water, and made the children of Israel drink [it].
texts.exo.32.21: And Moses said to Aaron, What has this people done to thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin on them?
texts.exo.32.22: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord burn! thou knowest the people, that they are [set] on mischief.
texts.exo.32.23: And they said to me, Make us a god, who will go before us; for this Moses, the man that has brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what is become of him!
texts.exo.32.24: And I said to them, Who has gold? They broke [it] off, and gave [it] me, and I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
texts.exo.32.25: And Moses saw the people how they were stripped; for Aaron had stripped them to [their] shame before their adversaries.
texts.exo.32.26: And Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, He that is for Jehovah, [let him come] to me. And all the sons of Levi gathered to him.
texts.exo.32.27: And he said to them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Put every man his sword upon his hip; go and return from gate to gate through the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his friend, and every man his neighbour.
texts.exo.32.28: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses; and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
texts.exo.32.29: And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves to-day to Jehovah, yea, every man with his son, and with his brother, and bring on yourselves a blessing to-day.
texts.exo.32.30: And it came to pass the next day, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to Jehovah: perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.
texts.exo.32.31: And Moses returned to Jehovah, and said, Alas, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made themselves a god of gold!
texts.exo.32.32: And now, if thou wilt forgive their sin ... but if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book that thou hast written.
texts.exo.32.33: And Jehovah said to Moses, Whoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
texts.exo.32.34: And now go, lead the people whither I have told thee: behold, my Angel shall go before thee; but in the day of my visiting I will visit their sin upon them.
texts.exo.32.35: And Jehovah smote the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron had made.
texts.exo.33.1: And Jehovah said to Moses, Depart, go up hence, thou and the people that thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, into the land that I swore unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it,
texts.exo.33.2: (and I will send an angel before thee, and dispossess the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,)
texts.exo.33.3: into a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in the midst of thee, for thou art a stiff-necked people, -- lest I consume thee on the way.
texts.exo.33.4: And when the people heard this evil word, they mourned; and no man put on his ornaments.
texts.exo.33.5: Now Jehovah had said to Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiff-necked people: in one moment I will come up into the midst of thee and will consume thee. And now put off thine ornaments from thee, and I will know what I will do unto thee.
texts.exo.33.6: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments at mount Horeb.
texts.exo.33.7: And Moses took the tent, and pitched it outside the camp, far from the camp, and called it the Tent of meeting. And it came to pass [that] every one who sought Jehovah went out to the tent of meeting which was outside the camp.
texts.exo.33.8: And it came to pass, when Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose up, and stood every man at the entrance of his tent, and they looked after Moses until he entered into the tent.
texts.exo.33.9: And it came to pass when Moses entered into the tent, the pillar of cloud descended, and stood at the entrance of the tent, and [Jehovah] talked with Moses.
texts.exo.33.10: And all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent; and all the people rose and worshipped, every man at the entrance of his tent.
texts.exo.33.11: And Jehovah spoke with Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. And he returned to the camp; but his attendant, Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, departed not from within the tent.
texts.exo.33.12: And Moses said to Jehovah, Behold, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people; but thou dost not let me know whom thou wilt send with me; and thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in mine eyes.
texts.exo.33.13: And now, if indeed I have found grace in thine eyes, make me now to know thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thine eyes; and consider that this nation is thy people!
texts.exo.33.14: And he said, My presence shall go, and I will give thee rest.
texts.exo.33.15: And he said to him, If thy presence do not go, bring us not up hence.
texts.exo.33.16: And how shall it be known then that I have found grace in thine eyes -- I and thy people? [Is it] not by thy going with us? so shall we be distinguished, I and thy people, from every people that is on the face of the earth.
texts.exo.33.17: And Jehovah said to Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast said; for thou hast found grace in mine eyes, and I know thee by name.
texts.exo.33.18: And he said, Let me, I pray thee, see thy glory.
texts.exo.33.19: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thy face, and I will proclaim the name of Jehovah before thee; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
texts.exo.33.20: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for Man shall not see me, and live.
texts.exo.33.21: And Jehovah said, Behold, [there is] a place by me: there shalt thou stand on the rock.
texts.exo.33.22: And it shall come to pass, when my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand, until I have passed by.
texts.exo.33.23: And I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see me from behind; but my face shall not be seen.
texts.exo.34.1: And Jehovah said to Moses, Hew for thyself two tables of stone like the first; and I will write upon the tables the words that were upon the first tables, which thou hast broken.
texts.exo.34.2: And be ready for the morning, and go up in the morning to mount Sinai, and stand there before me on the top of the mountain.
texts.exo.34.3: And let no man go up with thee, neither shall any man be seen on all the mountain; neither shall sheep and oxen feed in front of that mountain.
texts.exo.34.4: And he hewed two tables of stone like the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning and went up to mount Sinai, as Jehovah had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
texts.exo.34.5: And Jehovah came down in the cloud, and stood beside him there, and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.
texts.exo.34.6: And Jehovah passed by before his face, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah ùGod merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in goodness and truth,
texts.exo.34.7: keeping mercy unto thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, but by no means clearing [the guilty]; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, upon the third and upon the fourth [generation].
texts.exo.34.8: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head to the earth and worshipped,
texts.exo.34.9: and said, If indeed I have found grace in thine eyes, Lord, let the Lord, I pray thee, go in our midst; for it is a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for an inheritance!
texts.exo.34.10: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels that have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people in the midst of which thou [art] shall see the work of Jehovah; for a terrible thing it shall be that I will do with thee.
texts.exo.34.11: Observe what I command thee this day: behold, I will drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
texts.exo.34.12: Take heed to thyself, that thou make no covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which thou shalt come, lest it be a snare in the midst of thee;
texts.exo.34.13: but ye shall demolish their altars, shatter their statues, and hew down their Asherahs.
texts.exo.34.14: For thou shalt worship no other ùGod; for Jehovah -- Jealous is his name -- is a jealous ùGod;
texts.exo.34.15: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and then, when they go a whoring after their gods, and sacrifice unto their gods, thou be invited, and eat of their sacrifice,
texts.exo.34.16: and thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
texts.exo.34.17: -- Thou shalt make thyself no molten gods.
texts.exo.34.18: -- The feast of the unleavened bread shalt thou keep: seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, as I have commanded thee, at the appointed time of the month Abib; for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
texts.exo.34.19: -- All that openeth the womb [is] mine; and all the cattle that is born a male, the firstling of ox and sheep.
texts.exo.34.20: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt ransom with a lamb; and if thou ransom [it] not, then shalt thou break its neck. All the first-born of thy sons thou shalt ransom; and none shall appear before me empty.
texts.exo.34.21: -- Six days shalt thou work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest; in ploughing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
texts.exo.34.22: -- And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the first-fruits of wheat-harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the turn of the year.
texts.exo.34.23: Thrice in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.
texts.exo.34.24: For I will dispossess the nations before thee, and enlarge thy border, and no man shall desire thy land, when thou goest up to appear before the face of Jehovah thy God thrice in the year.
texts.exo.34.25: -- Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left over night until the morning.
texts.exo.34.26: -- The first of the first-fruits of thy land shalt thou bring into the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
texts.exo.34.27: And Jehovah said to Moses, Write thee these words; for after the tenor of these words have I made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
texts.exo.34.28: -- And he was there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; he ate no bread, and drank no water. -- And he wrote on the tables the words of the covenant, the ten words.
texts.exo.34.29: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai -- and the two tables of testimony were in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mountain -- that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone through his talking with him.
texts.exo.34.30: And Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
texts.exo.34.31: And Moses called to them; and they turned to him, -- Aaron and all the principal men of the assembly; and Moses talked with them.
texts.exo.34.32: And afterwards, all the children of Israel came near; and he gave them in commandment all that Jehovah had spoken with him on mount Sinai.
texts.exo.34.33: And Moses ended speaking with them; and he had put on his face a veil.
texts.exo.34.34: And when Moses went in before Jehovah to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel what he was commanded.
texts.exo.34.35: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone; and Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
texts.exo.35.1: And Moses collected all the assembly of the children of Israel, and said to them, These are the things which Jehovah has commanded, to do them.
texts.exo.35.2: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to Jehovah: whoever does work on it shall be put to death.
texts.exo.35.3: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your dwellings upon the sabbath day.
texts.exo.35.4: And Moses spoke to all the assembly of the children of Israel, saying, This is the word which Jehovah has commanded, saying,
texts.exo.35.5: Take from among you a heave-offering to Jehovah: every one whose heart [is] willing, let him bring it, Jehovah's heave-offering -- gold, and silver, and copper,
texts.exo.35.6: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and byssus, and goats' [hair],
texts.exo.35.7: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and acacia-wood,
texts.exo.35.8: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the incense of fragrant drugs;
texts.exo.35.9: and onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
texts.exo.35.10: And all who are wise-hearted among you shall come and make all that Jehovah has commanded:
texts.exo.35.11: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
texts.exo.35.12: the ark, and its staves; the mercy-seat, and the veil of separation;
texts.exo.35.13: the table and its staves, and all its utensils, and the shewbread;
texts.exo.35.14: and the lamp-stand for the light, and its utensils, and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
texts.exo.35.15: and the altar of incense, and its staves; and the anointing-oil, and the incense of fragrant drugs; and the entrance-curtain at the entrance of the tabernacle;
texts.exo.35.16: the altar of burnt-offering, and the copper grating for it, its staves, and all its utensils; the laver and its stand;
texts.exo.35.17: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases, and the curtains of the gate of the court;
texts.exo.35.18: the pegs of the tabernacle, and the pegs of the court, and their cords;
texts.exo.35.19: the garments of service, to do service in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.
texts.exo.35.20: And all the assembly of the children of Israel departed from before Moses.
texts.exo.35.21: And they came, every one whose heart moved him, and every one whose spirit prompted him; they brought Jehovah's heave-offering for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
texts.exo.35.22: And they came, both men and women; every one who was of willing heart brought nose-rings, and earrings, and rings, and bracelets, all kinds of utensils of gold: every man that waved a wave-offering of gold to Jehovah.
texts.exo.35.23: And every man with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and byssus, and goats' [hair], and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, brought [them].
texts.exo.35.24: All they that offered a heave-offering of silver and copper brought Jehovah's heave-offering. And every one with whom was found acacia-wood for all manner of work of the service, brought [it].
texts.exo.35.25: And every woman that was wise-hearted spun with her hands, and brought what she had spun: the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the byssus.
texts.exo.35.26: And all the women whose heart moved them in wisdom spun goats' [hair].
texts.exo.35.27: And the principal men brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
texts.exo.35.28: and the spice, and the oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the incense of fragrant drugs.
texts.exo.35.29: The children of Israel brought a voluntary offering to Jehovah, every man and woman whose heart prompted them to bring for all manner of work, which Jehovah, by the hand of Moses, had commanded to be done.
texts.exo.35.30: And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, Jehovah has called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
texts.exo.35.31: and he has filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
texts.exo.35.32: and to devise artistic things: to work in gold, and in silver, and in copper,
texts.exo.35.33: and in cutting of stones, for setting, and in carving of wood, to execute all artistic work;
texts.exo.35.34: and he has put in his heart to teach, he and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan:
texts.exo.35.35: he has filled them with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work of the engraver, and of the artificer, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in byssus, and of the weaver, [even] of them that do every kind of work, and of those that devise artistic work
texts.exo.36.1: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every man that was wise-hearted, in whom Jehovah had put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work of the service of the sanctuary -- according to all that Jehovah had commanded.
texts.exo.36.2: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every man that was wise-hearted, in whose heart God had put wisdom, every one whose heart moved him to come to the work to do it.
texts.exo.36.3: And they took from Moses every heave-offering that the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it. And they still brought him voluntary offerings morning by morning.
texts.exo.36.4: And all the wise men that wrought all the work of the sanctuary came, every man from his work which they wrought,
texts.exo.36.5: and spoke to Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work that Jehovah commanded to be done.
texts.exo.36.6: Then Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed through the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the heave-offering of the sanctuary! So the people were restrained from bringing;
texts.exo.36.7: for the work they had was sufficient for all the work to do it, and it was too much.
texts.exo.36.8: And every wise-hearted man among those that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of twined byssus, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: [with] cherubim of artistic work did he make them.
texts.exo.36.9: The length of one curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits -- one measure for all the curtains.
texts.exo.36.10: And he coupled five of the curtains one to another, and [the other] five curtains coupled he one to another.
texts.exo.36.11: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain at the edge of the coupling; he did likewise in the edge of the outermost curtain in the other coupling.
texts.exo.36.12: He made fifty loops in one curtain, and he made fifty loops at the end of the curtain that was in the other coupling: the loops were opposite to one another.
texts.exo.36.13: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle became one.
texts.exo.36.14: And he made curtains of goats' [hair] for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains did he make them.
texts.exo.36.15: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of one curtain -- one measure for the eleven curtains.
texts.exo.36.16: And he coupled five of the curtains by themselves, and six of the curtains by themselves.
texts.exo.36.17: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he on the edge of the curtain in the other coupling.
texts.exo.36.18: And he made fifty clasps of copper to couple the tent, that it might be one.
texts.exo.36.19: And he made a covering for the tent [of] rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above [that].
texts.exo.36.20: And he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia-wood, standing up;
texts.exo.36.21: ten cubits the length of the boards, and one cubit and a half the breadth of one board;
texts.exo.36.22: two tenons in one board, connected one with the other: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
texts.exo.36.23: And he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;
texts.exo.36.24: and he made forty bases of silver under the twenty boards, two bases under one board, for its two tenons, and two bases under another board for its two tenons.
texts.exo.36.25: And for the other side of the tabernacle, on the side toward the north, he made twenty boards,
texts.exo.36.26: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one board, and two bases under another board.
texts.exo.36.27: And at the rear of the tabernacle, westward, he made six boards;
texts.exo.36.28: and he made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the rear;
texts.exo.36.29: and they were joined beneath, and were coupled together at the top thereof into one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners;
texts.exo.36.30: and there were eight boards, and their silver bases: sixteen bases, under every board two bases.
texts.exo.36.31: -- And he made bars of acacia-wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
texts.exo.36.32: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle at the rear, westward.
texts.exo.36.33: And he made the middle bar in the midst of the boards reach from one end to the other.
texts.exo.36.34: And he overlaid the boards with gold; and made their rings of gold [as] receptacles for the bars; and overlaid the bars with gold.
texts.exo.36.35: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus: of artistic work he made it [with] cherubim.
texts.exo.36.36: And he made four pillars of acacia[-wood] for it, and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four bases of silver.
texts.exo.36.37: And he made a curtain for the entrance of the tent of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus, of embroidery;
texts.exo.36.38: and its five pillars with their hooks; and he overlaid their capitals and their connecting-rods with gold; and their five bases were of copper.
texts.exo.37.1: And Bezaleel made the ark of acacia-wood; two cubits and a half the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
texts.exo.37.2: And he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a border of gold upon it round about.
texts.exo.37.3: And he cast for it four rings of gold, for its four corners: two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
texts.exo.37.4: And he made staves of acacia-wood and overlaid them with gold.
texts.exo.37.5: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark.
texts.exo.37.6: -- And he made a mercy-seat of pure gold; two cubits and a half the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
texts.exo.37.7: And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work did he make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
texts.exo.37.8: one cherub at the end of one side, and one cherub at the end of the other side; out of the mercy-seat he made the two cherubim at the two ends thereof.
texts.exo.37.9: And the cherubim spread out [their] wings over it, covering over with their wings the mercy-seat; and their faces were opposite to one another: the faces of the cherubim were [turned] toward the mercy-seat.
texts.exo.37.10: And he made the table of acacia-wood; two cubits the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
texts.exo.37.11: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made upon it a border of gold round about.
texts.exo.37.12: And he made for it a margin of a hand-breadth round about; and made a border of gold for the margin thereof round about.
texts.exo.37.13: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that were on the four feet thereof.
texts.exo.37.14: Close to the margin were the rings, as receptacles of the staves to carry the table.
texts.exo.37.15: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
texts.exo.37.16: And he made the utensils that were on the table, the dishes thereof, and the cups thereof, and the bowls thereof, and the goblets with which to pour out, of pure gold.
texts.exo.37.17: And he made the candlestick of pure gold; [of] beaten work he made the candlestick: its base, and its shaft, its cups, its knobs, and its flowers were of itself.
texts.exo.37.18: And six branches went out of the sides thereof -- three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof;
texts.exo.37.19: [there were] three cups shaped like almonds in the one branch, a knob and a flower; and three cups shaped like almonds in the other branch, a knob and a flower: so in the six branches which went out of the candlestick.
texts.exo.37.20: And in the candlestick were four cups, shaped like almonds, its knobs, and its flowers;
texts.exo.37.21: and a knob under two branches thereof, and [again] a knob under two branches thereof, and [again] a knob under two branches thereof, for the six branches which went out of it.
texts.exo.37.22: Their knobs and their branches were of itself -- all of one beaten work of pure gold.
texts.exo.37.23: And he made the seven lamps thereof, and the snuffers thereof, and the snuff-trays thereof, of pure gold.
texts.exo.37.24: Of a talent of pure gold he made it, and all its utensils.
texts.exo.37.25: And he made the altar of incense of acacia-wood; a cubit the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, square, and two cubits the height thereof: its horns were of itself.
texts.exo.37.26: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and made upon it a border of gold round about.
texts.exo.37.27: And he made two rings of gold for it under its border, by its two corners, on the two sides thereof, as receptacles for the staves with which to carry it.
texts.exo.37.28: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold.
texts.exo.37.29: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of fragrant drugs, according to the work of the perfumer.
texts.exo.38.1: And he made the altar of burnt-offering of acacia-wood; five cubits the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof, square, and three cubits the height thereof.
texts.exo.38.2: And he made its horns on the four corners thereof; its horns were of itself; and he overlaid it with copper.
texts.exo.38.3: And he made all the utensils of the altar: the pots, and the shovels, and the bowls, the forks, and the firepans; all its utensils made he of copper.
texts.exo.38.4: And he made for the altar a grating of network of copper under its ledge from beneath, to the very middle of it.
texts.exo.38.5: And he cast four rings for the four corners of the grating of copper, as receptacles for the staves.
texts.exo.38.6: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with copper.
texts.exo.38.7: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. Hollow with boards did he make it.
texts.exo.38.8: And he made the laver of copper, and its stand of copper, of the mirrors of the crowds of women who crowded before the entrance of the tent of meeting.
texts.exo.38.9: And he made the court. On the south side southward, the hangings of the court were of twined byssus, a hundred cubits;
texts.exo.38.10: their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty, of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.
texts.exo.38.11: And on the north side, a hundred cubits; their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty, of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.
texts.exo.38.12: And on the west side, hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their bases ten; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver.
texts.exo.38.13: And for the east side, eastward, fifty cubits;
texts.exo.38.14: the hangings on the one wing of fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their bases three;
texts.exo.38.15: and on the other wing, on this side as on that side of the gate of the court, hangings of fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their bases three.
texts.exo.38.16: All the hangings of the court round about were of twined byssus;
texts.exo.38.17: and the bases of the pillars of copper, the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-rods of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals of silver; and all the pillars of the court were fastened together with [rods of] silver.
texts.exo.38.18: -- And the curtain of the gate of the court was of embroidery of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus; and the length was twenty cubits, and the height like the breadth, five cubits, just as the hangings of the court;
texts.exo.38.19: and their pillars four, and their bases four, of copper; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their connecting-rods of silver.
texts.exo.38.20: And all the pegs for the tabernacle and for the court round about were of copper.
texts.exo.38.21: These are the things numbered of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, which were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, by the service of the Levites, under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.
texts.exo.38.22: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Jehovah had commanded Moses;
texts.exo.38.23: and with him Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and artificer, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in byssus.
texts.exo.38.24: All the gold that it took for the work in all the work of the sanctuary -- the gold of the wave-offering, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
texts.exo.38.25: And the silver of them that were numbered of the assembly was a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
texts.exo.38.26: a bekah the head -- half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that passed the numbering from twenty years old and upward, [of] the six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
texts.exo.38.27: And there were a hundred talents of silver for casting the bases of the sanctuary, and the bases of the veil; a hundred bases of a hundred talents, a talent for a base.
texts.exo.38.28: And of the thousand seven hundred and seventy-five [shekels] he made the hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and fastened them [with rods].
texts.exo.38.29: And the copper of the wave-offering was seventy talents, and two thousand four hundred shekels.
texts.exo.38.30: And he made with it the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the copper altar, and the copper grating for it, and all the utensils of the altar.
texts.exo.38.31: And the bases of the court round about, and the bases of the gate of the court, and all the pegs of the tabernacle, and all the pegs of the court round about.
texts.exo.39.1: And of the blue and purple and scarlet they made garments of service, for service in the sanctuary, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.2: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus.
texts.exo.39.3: And they beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it [into] wires, to work it artistically into the blue, and into the purple, and into the scarlet, and into the byssus.
texts.exo.39.4: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joining it: at its two ends was it joined together.
texts.exo.39.5: And the girdle of his ephod, which was on it, was of the same, according to its work, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.6: And they wrought the onyx stones mounted in enclosures of gold, engraved with the engravings of a seal, according to the names of the sons of Israel.
texts.exo.39.7: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, [as] stones of memorial for the children of Israel; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.8: And he made the breastplate of artistic work, like the work of the ephod, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined byssus.
texts.exo.39.9: It was square; double did they make the breastplate, a span the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, doubled.
texts.exo.39.10: And they set in it four rows of stones: [one] row, a sardoin, a topaz, and an emerald -- the first row;
texts.exo.39.11: and the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a diamond;
texts.exo.39.12: and the third row, an opal, an agate, and an amethyst;
texts.exo.39.13: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper; mounted in enclosures of gold in their settings.
texts.exo.39.14: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, engraved as a seal, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
texts.exo.39.15: And they made on the breastplate chains of laced work of wreathen work, of pure gold.
texts.exo.39.16: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
texts.exo.39.17: And they put the two wreathen [cords] of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate;
texts.exo.39.18: and the two ends of the two wreathen [cords] they fastened to the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, on the front thereof.
texts.exo.39.19: And they made two rings of gold, and put [them] on the two ends of the breastplate, on the border thereof, which faceth the ephod inwards.
texts.exo.39.20: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, to the front thereof, just by the coupling thereof, above the girdle of the ephod.
texts.exo.39.21: And they bound the breastplate with its rings to the rings of the ephod with lace of blue, that it might be above the girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.22: And he made the cloak of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;
texts.exo.39.23: and the opening of the cloak in its middle, as the opening of a coat of mail; a binding was round about the opening, that it should not rend.
texts.exo.39.24: And they made on the skirts of the cloak pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet, twined.
texts.exo.39.25: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates, in the skirts of the cloak, round about, between the pomegranates:
texts.exo.39.26: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, in the skirts of the cloak round about, for service; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.27: And they made the vests of byssus of woven work, for Aaron, and for his sons;
texts.exo.39.28: and the turban of byssus; and the ornamental caps, of byssus; and the linen trousers, of twined byssus;
texts.exo.39.29: and the girdle, of twined byssus, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of embroidery; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.30: And they made the thin plate, the holy diadem, of pure gold, and wrote on it with the writing of the engravings of a seal, Holiness to Jehovah!
texts.exo.39.31: And they fastened to it a lace of blue, to fasten [it] on the turban above; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.39.32: And all the labour of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was ended; and the children of Israel had done [it] according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses -- so had they done [it].
texts.exo.39.33: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses -- the tent, and all its utensils, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its bases;
texts.exo.39.34: and the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the veil of separation;
texts.exo.39.35: the ark of the testimony, and its staves, and the mercy-seat;
texts.exo.39.36: the table, all its utensils, and the shewbread;
texts.exo.39.37: the pure candlestick, its lamps, the lamps set in order, and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
texts.exo.39.38: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the incense of fragrant drugs; and the curtain for the entrance of the tent;
texts.exo.39.39: the copper altar, and the copper grating that was for it, its staves and all its utensils; the laver and its stand;
texts.exo.39.40: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases; and the curtain for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the vessel's of service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
texts.exo.39.41: the garments of service, for service in the sanctuary; the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to serve as priests.
texts.exo.39.42: According to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so had the children of Israel done all the labour.
texts.exo.39.43: And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Jehovah had commanded -- so had they done [it]; and Moses blessed them.
texts.exo.40.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.exo.40.2: On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
texts.exo.40.3: And thou shalt put in it the ark of the testimony, and shalt cover the ark with the veil.
texts.exo.40.4: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it. And thou shalt bring in the candlestick and light its lamps.
texts.exo.40.5: And thou shalt set the golden altar for the incense before the ark of the testimony; and hang up the curtain of the entrance to the tabernacle.
texts.exo.40.6: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
texts.exo.40.7: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water in it.
texts.exo.40.8: And thou shalt fix the court round about, and hang up the curtain at the gate of the court.
texts.exo.40.9: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is in it, and shalt hallow it, and all its utensils; and it shall be holy.
texts.exo.40.10: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its utensils; and thou shalt hallow the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.
texts.exo.40.11: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its stand, and hallow it.
texts.exo.40.12: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons near, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and bathe them with water.
texts.exo.40.13: And thou shalt clothe Aaron with the holy garments, and anoint him, and hallow him, that he may serve me as priest.
texts.exo.40.14: And thou shalt bring his sons near, and clothe them with vests.
texts.exo.40.15: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may serve me as priests. And their anointing shall be to them an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
texts.exo.40.16: And Moses did so: as Jehovah had commanded him, so did he.
texts.exo.40.17: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, that the tabernacle was set up.
texts.exo.40.18: And Moses set up the tabernacle, and put in its bases, and fixed its boards, and put in its bars, and set up its pillars.
texts.exo.40.19: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above over it; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.20: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and put the staves in the ark, and put the mercy-seat above on the ark.
texts.exo.40.21: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and hung up the veil of separation, and covered the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.22: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil,
texts.exo.40.23: and arranged the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.24: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, opposite to the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
texts.exo.40.25: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.26: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil.
texts.exo.40.27: And he burnt on it fragrant incense; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.28: And he hung up the curtain of the entrance to the tabernacle.
texts.exo.40.29: And he put the altar of burnt-offering at the entrance to the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt-offering and the oblation; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.30: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.
texts.exo.40.31: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet out of it:
texts.exo.40.32: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they drew near to the altar, they washed; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.exo.40.33: And he set up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the curtain of the gate of the court. And so Moses finished the work.
texts.exo.40.34: And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.
texts.exo.40.35: And Moses could not enter into the tent of meeting, for the cloud abode on it, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.
texts.exo.40.36: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel journeyed in all their journeys.
texts.exo.40.37: And if the cloud were not taken up, then they did not journey until the day that it was taken up.
texts.exo.40.38: For the cloud of Jehovah was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

texts.exo.1.1: And these [are] the names of the sons of Israel who are coming into Egypt with Jacob; a man and his household have they come;
texts.exo.1.4: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
texts.exo.1.5: And all the persons coming out of the thigh of Jacob are seventy persons; as to Joseph, he was in Egypt.
texts.exo.1.6: And Joseph dieth, and all his brethren, and all that generation;
texts.exo.1.7: and the sons of Israel have been fruitful, and they teem, and multiply, and are very very mighty, and the land is filled with them.
texts.exo.1.8: And there riseth a new king over Egypt, who hath not known Joseph,
texts.exo.1.9: and he saith unto his people, `Lo, the people of the sons of Israel [is] more numerous and mighty than we;
texts.exo.1.10: give help! let us act wisely concerning it, lest it multiply, and it hath come to pass, when war happeneth, that it hath been joined, even it, unto those hating us, and hath fought against us, and hath gone out up of the land.'
texts.exo.1.11: And they set over it princes of tribute, so as to afflict it with their burdens, and it buildeth store-cities for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses;
texts.exo.1.12: and as they afflict it, so it multiplieth, and so it breaketh forth, and they are vexed because of the sons of Israel;
texts.exo.1.13: and the Egyptians cause the sons of Israel to serve with rigour,
texts.exo.1.14: and make their lives bitter in hard service, in clay, and in brick, and in every [kind] of service in the field; all their service in which they have served [is] with rigour.
texts.exo.1.15: And the king of Egypt speaketh to the midwives, the Hebrewesses, (of whom the name of the one [is] Shiphrah, and the name of the second Puah),
texts.exo.1.16: and saith, `When ye cause the Hebrew women to bear, and have looked on the children; if it [is] a son -- then ye have put him to death; and if it [is] a daughter -- then she hath lived.'
texts.exo.1.17: And the midwives fear God, and have not done as the king of Egypt hath spoken unto them, and keep the lads alive;
texts.exo.1.18: and the king of Egypt calleth for the midwives, and saith to them, `Wherefore have ye done this thing, and keep the lads alive?'
texts.exo.1.19: And the midwives say unto Pharaoh, `Because the Hebrew women [are] not as the Egyptian women, for they [are] lively; before the midwife cometh in unto them -- they have borne!'
texts.exo.1.20: And God doth good to the midwives, and the people multiply, and are very mighty;
texts.exo.1.21: and it cometh to pass, because the midwives have feared God, that He maketh for them households;
texts.exo.1.22: and Pharaoh layeth a charge on all his people, saying, `Every son who is born -- into the River ye do cast him, and every daughter ye do keep alive.'
texts.exo.2.1: And there goeth a man of the house of Levi, and he taketh the daughter of Levi,
texts.exo.2.2: and the woman conceiveth, and beareth a son, and she seeth him that he [is] fair, and she hideth him three months,
texts.exo.2.3: and she hath not been able any more to hide him, and she taketh for him an ark of rushes, and daubeth it with bitumen and with pitch, and putteth the lad in it, and putteth [it] in the weeds by the edge of the River;
texts.exo.2.4: and his sister stationeth herself afar off, to know what is done to him.
texts.exo.2.5: And a daughter of Pharaoh cometh down to bathe at the River, and her damsels are walking by the side of the River, and she seeth the ark in the midst of the weeds, and sendeth her handmaid, and she taketh it,
texts.exo.2.6: and openeth, and seeth him -- the lad, and lo, a child weeping! and she hath pity on him, and saith, `This is [one] of the Hebrews' children.'
texts.exo.2.7: And his sister saith unto the daughter of Pharaoh, `Do I go? when I have called for thee a suckling woman of the Hebrews, then she doth suckle the lad for thee;'
texts.exo.2.8: and the daughter of Pharaoh saith to her, `Go;' and the virgin goeth, and calleth the mother of the lad,
texts.exo.2.9: and the daughter of Pharaoh saith to her, `Take this lad away, and suckle him for me, and I -- I give thy hire;' and the woman taketh the lad, and suckleth him.
texts.exo.2.10: And the lad groweth, and she bringeth him in to the daughter of Pharaoh, and he is to her for a son, and she calleth his name Moses, and saith, `Because -- from the water I have drawn him.'
texts.exo.2.11: And it cometh to pass, in those days, that Moses is grown, and he goeth out unto his brethren, and looketh on their burdens, and seeth a man, an Egyptian, smiting a man, a Hebrew, [one] of his brethren,
texts.exo.2.12: and he turneth hither and thither, and seeth that there is no man, and smiteth the Egyptian, and hideth him in the sand.
texts.exo.2.13: And he goeth out on the second day, and lo, two men, Hebrews, striving! and he saith to the wrong-doer, `Why dost thou smite thy neighbour?'
texts.exo.2.14: and he saith, `Who set thee for a head and a judge over us? to slay me art thou saying [it], as thou hast slain the Egyptian?' and Moses feareth, and saith, `Surely the thing hath been known.'
texts.exo.2.15: And Pharaoh heareth of this thing, and seeketh to slay Moses, and Moses fleeth from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelleth in the land of Midian, and dwelleth by the well.
texts.exo.2.16: And to a priest of Midian [are] seven daughters, and they come and draw, and fill the troughs, to water the flock of their father,
texts.exo.2.17: and the shepherds come and drive them away, and Moses ariseth, and saveth them, and watereth their flock.
texts.exo.2.18: And they come in to Reuel their father, and he saith, `Wherefore have ye hastened to come in to-day?'
texts.exo.2.19: and they say, `A man, an Egyptian, hath delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also hath diligently drawn for us, and watereth the flock;'
texts.exo.2.20: and he saith unto his daughters, `And where [is] he? why [is] this? -- ye left the man! call for him, and he doth eat bread.'
texts.exo.2.21: And Moses is willing to dwell with the man, and he giveth Zipporah his daughter to Moses,
texts.exo.2.22: and she beareth a son, and he calleth his name Gershom, for he said, `A sojourner I have been in a strange land.'
texts.exo.2.23: And it cometh to pass during these many days, that the king of Egypt dieth, and the sons of Israel sigh because of the service, and cry, and their cry goeth up unto God, because of the service;
texts.exo.2.24: and God heareth their groaning, and God remembereth His covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob;
texts.exo.2.25: and God seeth the sons of Israel, and God knoweth.
texts.exo.3.1: And Moses hath been feeding the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, priest of Midian, and he leadeth the flock behind the wilderness, and cometh in unto the mount of God, to Horeb;
texts.exo.3.2: and there appeareth unto him a messenger of Jehovah in a flame of fire, out of the midst of the bush, and he seeth, and lo, the bush is burning with fire, and the bush is not consumed.
texts.exo.3.3: And Moses saith, `Let me turn aside, I pray thee, and I see this great appearance; wherefore is the bush not burned?'
texts.exo.3.4: and Jehovah seeth that he hath turned aside to see, and God calleth unto him out of the midst of the bush, and saith, `Moses, Moses;' and he saith, `Here [am] I.'
texts.exo.3.5: And He saith, `Come not near hither: cast thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place on which thou art standing is holy ground.'
texts.exo.3.6: He saith also, `I [am] the God of thy father, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob;' and Moses hideth his face, for he is afraid to look towards God.
texts.exo.3.7: And Jehovah saith, `I have certainly seen the affliction of My people who [are] in Egypt, and their cry I have heard, because of its exactors, for I have known its pains;
texts.exo.3.8: and I go down to deliver it out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to cause it to go up out of the land, unto a land good and broad, unto a land flowing with milk and honey -- unto the place of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
texts.exo.3.9: `And now, lo, the cry of the sons of Israel hath come in unto Me, and I have also seen the oppression with which the Egyptians are oppressing them,
texts.exo.3.10: and now, come, and I send thee unto Pharaoh, and bring thou out My people, the sons of Israel, out of Egypt.'
texts.exo.3.11: And Moses saith unto God, `Who [am] I, that I go unto Pharaoh, and that I bring out the sons of Israel from Egypt?'
texts.exo.3.12: and He saith, `Because I am with thee, and this [is] to thee the sign that I have sent thee: in thy bringing out the people from Egypt -- ye do serve God on this mount.'
texts.exo.3.13: And Moses saith unto God, `Lo, I am coming unto the sons of Israel, and have said to them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you, and they have said to me, What [is] His name? what do I say unto them?'
texts.exo.3.14: And God saith unto Moses, `I AM THAT WHICH I AM;' He saith also, `Thus dost thou say to the sons of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.'
texts.exo.3.15: And God saith again unto Moses, `Thus dost thou say unto the sons of Israel, Jehovah, God of your fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you; this [is] My name -- to the age, and this My memorial, to generation -- generation.
texts.exo.3.16: `Go, and thou hast gathered the elders of Israel, and hast said unto them: Jehovah, God of your fathers, hath appeareth unto me, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, I have certainly inspected you, and that which is done to you in Egypt;
texts.exo.3.17: and I say, I bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt, unto the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, unto a land flowing [with] milk and honey.
texts.exo.3.18: `And they have hearkened to thy voice, and thou hast entered, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye have said unto him, Jehovah, God of the Hebrews, hath met with us; and now, let us go, we pray thee, a journey of three days into the wilderness, and we sacrifice to Jehovah our God.
texts.exo.3.19: `And I -- I have known that the king of Egypt doth not permit you to go, unless by a strong hand,
texts.exo.3.20: and I have put forth My hand, and have smitten Egypt with all My wonders, which I do in its midst -- and afterwards he doth send you away.
texts.exo.3.21: `And I have given the grace of this people in the eyes of the Egyptians, and it hath come to pass, when ye go, ye go not empty;
texts.exo.3.22: and [every] woman hath asked from her neighbour, and from her who is sojourning in her house, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and ye have put [them] on your sons and on your daughters, and have spoiled the Egyptians.'
texts.exo.4.1: And Moses answereth and saith, `And, if they do not give credence to me, nor hearken to my voice, and say, Jehovah hath not appeared unto thee?'
texts.exo.4.2: And Jehovah saith unto him, `What [is] this in thy hand?' and he saith, `A rod;'
texts.exo.4.3: and He saith, `Cast it to the earth;' and he casteth it to the earth, and it becometh a serpent -- and Moses fleeth from its presence.
texts.exo.4.4: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Put forth thy hand, and lay hold on the tail of it;' and he putteth forth his hand, and layeth hold on it, and it becometh a rod in his hand --
texts.exo.4.5: `-- so that they believe that Jehovah, God of their fathers, hath appeared unto thee, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob.'
texts.exo.4.6: And Jehovah saith to him again, `Put in, I pray thee, thy hand into thy bosom;' and he putteth in his hand into his bosom, and he bringeth it out, and lo, his hand [is] leprous as snow;
texts.exo.4.7: and He saith, `Put back thy hand unto thy bosom;' and he putteth back his hand unto his bosom, and he bringeth it out from his bosom, and lo, it hath turned back as his flesh --
texts.exo.4.8: `-- and it hath come to pass, if they do not give credence to thee, and hearken not to the voice of the first sign, that they have given credence to the voice of the latter sign.
texts.exo.4.9: `And it hath come to pass, if they do not give credence even to these two signs, nor hearken to thy voice, that thou hast taken of the waters of the River, and hast poured on the dry land, and the waters which thou takest from the River have been, yea, they have become -- blood on the dry land.'
texts.exo.4.10: And Moses saith unto Jehovah, `O, my Lord, I [am] not a man of words, either yesterday, or before, or since Thy speaking unto Thy servant, for I [am] slow of mouth, and slow of tongue.'
texts.exo.4.11: And Jehovah saith unto him, `Who appointed a mouth for man? or who appointeth the dumb, or deaf, or open, or blind? is it not I, Jehovah?
texts.exo.4.12: and now, go, and I -- I am with thy mouth, and have directed thee that which thou speakest;'
texts.exo.4.13: and he saith, `O, my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand Thou dost send.'
texts.exo.4.14: And the anger of Jehovah burneth against Moses, and He saith, `Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I have known that he speaketh well, and also, lo, he is coming out to meet thee; when he hath seen thee, then he hath rejoiced in his heart,
texts.exo.4.15: and thou hast spoken unto him, and hast set the words in his mouth, and I -- I am with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and have directed you that which ye do;
texts.exo.4.16: and he, he hath spoken for thee unto the people, and it hath come to pass, he -- he is to thee for a mouth, and thou -- thou art to him for God;
texts.exo.4.17: and this rod thou dost take in thy hand, with which thou doest the signs.'
texts.exo.4.18: And Moses goeth and turneth back unto Jethro his father-in-law, and saith to him, `Let me go, I pray thee, and I turn back unto my brethren who [are] in Egypt, and I see whether they are yet alive.' And Jethro saith to Moses, `Go in peace.'
texts.exo.4.19: And Jehovah saith unto Moses in Midian, `Go, turn back to Egypt, for all the men have died who seek thy life;'
texts.exo.4.20: and Moses taketh his wife, and his sons, and causeth them to ride on the ass, and turneth back to the land of Egypt, and Moses taketh the rod of God in his hand.
texts.exo.4.21: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `In thy going to turn back to Egypt, see -- all the wonders which I have put in thy hand -- that thou hast done them before Pharaoh, and I -- I strengthen his heart, and he doth not send the people away;
texts.exo.4.22: and thou hast said unto Pharaoh, Thus said Jehovah, My son, My first-born [is] Israel,
texts.exo.4.23: and I say unto thee, Send away My son, and he doth serve Me; and -- thou dost refuse to send him away -- lo, I am slaying thy son, thy first-born.'
texts.exo.4.24: And it cometh to pass in the way, in a lodging place, that Jehovah meeteth him, and seeketh to put him to death;
texts.exo.4.25: and Zipporah taketh a flint, and cutteth off the foreskin of her son, and causeth [it] to touch his feet, and saith, `Surely a bridegroom of blood [art] thou to me;'
texts.exo.4.26: and He desisteth from him: then she said, `A bridegroom of blood,' in reference to the circumcision.
texts.exo.4.27: And Jehovah saith unto Aaron, `Go to meet Moses into the wilderness;' and he goeth, and meeteth him in the mount of God, and kisseth him,
texts.exo.4.28: and Moses declareth to Aaron all the words of Jehovah with which He hath sent him, and all the signs with which He hath charged him.
texts.exo.4.29: And Moses goeth -- Aaron also -- and they gather all the elders of the sons of Israel,
texts.exo.4.30: and Aaron speaketh all the words which Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses, and doth the signs before the eyes of the people;
texts.exo.4.31: and the people believe when they hear that Jehovah hath looked after the sons of Israel, and that He hath seen their affliction; and they bow and do obeisance.
texts.exo.5.1: And afterwards have Moses and Aaron entered, and they say unto Pharaoh, `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Send My people away, and they keep a feast to Me in the wilderness;'
texts.exo.5.2: and Pharaoh saith, `Who [is] Jehovah, that I hearken to His voice, to send Israel away? I have not known Jehovah, and Israel also I do not send away.'
texts.exo.5.3: And they say, `The God of the Hebrews hath met with us, let us go, we pray thee, a journey of three days into the wilderness, and we sacrifice to Jehovah our God, lest He meet us with pestilence or with sword.'
texts.exo.5.4: And the king of Egypt saith unto them, `Why, Moses and Aaron, do ye free the people from its works? go to your burdens.'
texts.exo.5.5: Pharaoh also saith, `Lo, numerous now [is] the people of the land, and ye have caused them to cease from their burdens!'
