texts.exo.22.26: if thou dost at all take in pledge the garment of thy neighbour, during the going in of the sun thou dost return it to him:
texts.exo.22.27: for it alone is his covering, it [is] his garment for his skin; wherein doth he lie down? and it hath come to pass, when he doth cry unto Me, that I have heard, for I [am] gracious.
texts.exo.22.28: `God thou dost not revile, and a prince among thy people thou dost not curse.
texts.exo.22.29: `Thy fulness and thy liquids thou dost not delay; the first-born of thy sons thou dost give to Me;
texts.exo.22.30: so thou dost to thine ox, to thy sheep; seven days it is with its dam, on the eighth day thou dost give it to Me.
texts.exo.22.31: `And ye are holy men to Me, and flesh torn in the field ye do not eat, to a dog ye do cast it.
texts.exo.23.1: `Thou dost not lift up a vain report; thou dost not put thy hand with a wicked man to be a violent witness.
texts.exo.23.2: `Thou art not after many to evil, nor dost thou testify concerning a strife, to turn aside after many to cause [others] to turn aside;
texts.exo.23.3: and a poor man thou dost not honour in his strife.
texts.exo.23.4: `When thou meetest thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou dost certainly turn it back to him;
texts.exo.23.5: when thou seest the ass of him who is hating thee crouching under its burden, then thou hast ceased from leaving [it] to it -- thou dost certainly leave [it] with him.
texts.exo.23.6: `Thou dost not turn aside the judgment of thy needy one in his strife;
texts.exo.23.7: from a false matter thou dost keep far off, and an innocent and righteous man thou dost not slay; for I do not justify a wicked man.
texts.exo.23.8: `And a bribe thou dost not take; for the bribe bindeth the open-[eyed], and perverteth the words of the righteous.
texts.exo.23.9: `And a sojourner thou dost not oppress, and ye -- ye have known the soul of the sojourner, for sojourners ye have been in the land of Egypt.
texts.exo.23.10: `And six years thou dost sow thy land, and hast gathered its increase;
texts.exo.23.11: and the seventh thou dost release it, and hast left it, and the needy of thy people have eaten, and their leaving doth the beast of the field eat; so dost thou to thy vineyard -- to thine olive-yard.
texts.exo.23.12: `Six days thou dost do thy work, and on the seventh day thou dost rest, so that thine ox and thine ass doth rest, and the son of thine handmaid and the sojourner is refreshed;
texts.exo.23.13: and in all that which I have said unto you ye do take heed; and the name of other gods ye do not mention; it is not heard on thy mouth.
texts.exo.23.14: `Three times thou dost keep a feast to Me in a year;
texts.exo.23.15: the Feast of Unleavened things thou dost keep; seven days thou dost eat unleavened things, as I have commanded thee, at the time appointed [in] the month of Abib; for in it thou hast come forth out of Egypt, and ye do not appear [in] My presence empty;
texts.exo.23.16: and the Feast of Harvest, the first fruits of thy works which thou sowest in the field; and the Feast of the In-Gathering, in the outgoing of the year, in thy gathering thy works out of the field.
texts.exo.23.17: `Three times in a year do all thy males appear before the face of the Lord Jehovah.
texts.exo.23.18: `Thou dost not sacrifice on a fermented thing the blood of My sacrifice, and the fat of My festival doth not remain till morning;
texts.exo.23.19: the beginning of the first-fruits of thy ground thou dost bring into the house of Jehovah thy God; thou dost not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
texts.exo.23.20: `Lo, I am sending a messenger before thee to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee in unto the place which I have prepared;
texts.exo.23.21: be watchful because of his presence, and hearken to his voice, rebel not against him, for he beareth not with your transgression, for My name [is] in his heart;
texts.exo.23.22: for, if thou diligently hearken to his voice, and hast done all that which I speak, then I have been at enmity with thine enemies, and have distressed those distressing thee.
texts.exo.23.23: `For My messenger goeth before thee, and hath brought thee in unto the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, and I have cut them off.
texts.exo.23.24: `Thou dost not bow thyself to their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their doings, but dost utterly devote them, and thoroughly break their standing pillars.
texts.exo.23.25: `And ye have served Jehovah your God, and He hath blessed thy bread and thy water, and I have turned aside sickness from thine heart;
texts.exo.23.26: there is not a miscarrying and barren one in thy land; the number of thy days I fulfil:
texts.exo.23.27: My terror I send before thee, and I have put to death all the people among whom thou comest, and I have given the neck of all thine enemies unto thee.
texts.exo.23.28: `And I have sent the hornet before thee, and it hath cast out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee;
texts.exo.23.29: I cast them not out from before thee in one year, lest the land be a desolation, and the beast of the field hath multiplied against thee;
texts.exo.23.30: little [by] little I cast them out from before thee, till thou art fruitful, and hast inherited the land.
texts.exo.23.31: `And I have set thy border from the Red Sea, even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness unto the River: for I give into your hand the inhabitants of the land, and thou hast cast them out from before thee;
texts.exo.23.32: thou dost not make a covenant with them, and with their gods;
texts.exo.23.33: they do not dwell in thy land, lest they cause thee to sin against Me when thou servest their gods, when it becometh a snare to thee.'
texts.exo.24.1: And unto Moses He said, `Come up unto Jehovah, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and ye have bowed yourselves afar off;'
texts.exo.24.2: and Moses hath drawn nigh by himself unto Jehovah; and they draw not nigh, and the people go not up with him.
texts.exo.24.3: And Moses cometh in, and recounteth to the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the judgments, and all the people answer -- one voice, and say, `All the words which Jehovah hath spoken we do.'
texts.exo.24.4: And Moses writeth all the words of Jehovah, and riseth early in the morning, and buildeth an altar under the hill, and twelve standing pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel;
texts.exo.24.5: and he sendeth the youths of the sons of Israel, and they cause burnt-offerings to ascend, and sacrifice sacrifices of peace-offerings to Jehovah -- calves.
texts.exo.24.6: And Moses taketh half of the blood, and putteth in basins, and half of the blood hath he sprinkled on the altar;
texts.exo.24.7: and he taketh the Book of the Covenant, and proclaimeth in the ears of the people, and they say, `All that which Jehovah hath spoken we do, and obey.'
texts.exo.24.8: And Moses taketh the blood, and sprinkleth on the people, and saith, `Lo, the blood of the covenant which Jehovah hath made with you, concerning all these things.'
texts.exo.24.9: And Moses goeth up, Aaron also, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
texts.exo.24.10: and they see the God of Israel, and under His feet [is] as the white work of the sapphire, and as the substance of the heavens for purity;
texts.exo.24.11: and unto those of the sons of Israel who are near He hath not put forth His hand, and they see God, and eat and drink.
texts.exo.24.12: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Come up unto Me to the mount, and be there, and I give to thee the tables of stone, and the law, and the command, which I have written to direct them.'
texts.exo.24.13: And Moses riseth -- Joshua his minister also -- and Moses goeth up unto the mount of God;
texts.exo.24.14: and unto the elders he hath said, `Abide ye for us in this [place], until that we turn back unto you, and lo, Aaron and Hur [are] with you -- he who hath matters doth come nigh unto them.'
texts.exo.24.15: And Moses goeth up unto the mount, and the cloud covereth the mount;
texts.exo.24.16: and the honour of Jehovah doth tabernacle on mount Sinai, and the cloud covereth it six days, and He calleth unto Moses on the seventh day from the midst of the cloud.
texts.exo.24.17: And the appearance of the honour of Jehovah [is] as a consuming fire on the top of the mount, before the eyes of the sons of Israel;
texts.exo.24.18: and Moses goeth into the midst of the cloud, and goeth up unto the mount, and Moses is on the mount forty days and forty nights.
texts.exo.25.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.exo.25.2: `Speak unto the sons of Israel, and they take for Me a heave-offering; from every man whose heart impelleth him ye do take My heave-offering.
texts.exo.25.3: `And this [is] the heave-offering which ye take from them; gold, and silver, and brass,
texts.exo.25.4: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' [hair],
texts.exo.25.5: and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
texts.exo.25.6: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil, and for the perfume of the spices,
texts.exo.25.7: shoham stones, and stones for setting for an ephod, and for a breastplate.
texts.exo.25.8: `And they have made for Me a sanctuary, and I have tabernacled in their midst;
texts.exo.25.9: according to all that which I am shewing thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all its vessels, even so ye do make [it].
texts.exo.25.10: `And they have made an ark of shittim wood; two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height;
texts.exo.25.11: and thou hast overlaid it [with] pure gold, within and without thou dost overlay it, and thou hast made on it a ring of gold round about.
texts.exo.25.12: `And thou hast cast for it four rings of gold, and hast put [them] on its four feet, even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its second side;
texts.exo.25.13: and thou hast made staves of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them [with] gold,
texts.exo.25.14: and hast brought the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark by them,
texts.exo.25.15: in the rings of the ark are the staves, they are not turned aside from it;
texts.exo.25.16: and thou hast put unto the ark the testimony which I give unto thee.
texts.exo.25.17: `And thou hast made a mercy-seat of pure gold, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth;
texts.exo.25.18: and thou hast made two cherubs of gold, beaten work dost thou make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
texts.exo.25.19: and make thou one cherub at the end on this side, and one cherub at the end on that; at the mercy-seat ye do make the cherubs on its two ends.
texts.exo.25.20: `And the cherubs have been spreading out wings on high, covering the mercy-seat over with their wings, and their faces [are] one towards another -- towards the mercy-seat are the faces of the cherubs.
texts.exo.25.21: `And thou hast put the mercy-seat on the ark above, and unto the ark thou dost put the testimony which I give unto thee;
texts.exo.25.22: and I have met with thee there, and have spoken with thee from off the mercy-seat (from between the two cherubs, which [are] on the ark of the testimony) all that which I command thee concerning the sons of Israel.
texts.exo.25.23: `And thou hast made a table of shittim wood, two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height,
texts.exo.25.24: and hast overlaid it [with] pure gold, and hast made for it a crown of gold round about,
texts.exo.25.25: and hast made for it a border of a handbreadth round about, and hast made a crown of gold to its border round about.
texts.exo.25.26: `And thou hast made to it four rings of gold, and hast put the rings on the four corners, which [are] to its four feet;
texts.exo.25.27: over-against the border are the rings for places for staves to bear the table;
texts.exo.25.28: and thou hast made the staves of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them with gold, and the table hath been borne with them;
texts.exo.25.29: and thou hast made its dishes, and its bowls, and its covers, and its cups, with which they pour out; of pure gold thou dost make them;
texts.exo.25.30: and thou hast put on the table bread of the presence before Me continually.
texts.exo.25.31: `And thou hast made a candlestick of pure gold, of beaten work is the candlestick made; its base, and its branch, its calyxes, its knops, and its flowers are of the same;
texts.exo.25.32: and six branches are coming out of its sides, three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the second side;
texts.exo.25.33: three calyxes made like almonds in the one branch, a knop and a flower, and three calyxes made like almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; so for the six branches which are coming out from the candlestick.
texts.exo.25.34: `And in the candlestick [are] four calyxes made like almonds, its knops and its flowers;
texts.exo.25.35: and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, [are] to the six branches which are coming out of the candlestick;
texts.exo.25.36: their knops and their branches are of the same, all of it one beaten work of pure gold;
texts.exo.25.37: and thou hast made its seven lamps, and [one] hath caused its lights to go up, and it hath given light over-against its front.
texts.exo.25.38: `And its snuffers and its snuff dishes [are] of pure gold;
texts.exo.25.39: of a talent of pure gold he doth make it, with all these vessels.
texts.exo.25.40: And see thou and do [them] by their pattern which thou art shewn in the mount.
texts.exo.26.1: `And thou dost make the tabernacle: ten curtains of twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet; [with] cherubs, work of a designer, thou dost make them;
texts.exo.26.2: the length of the one curtain [is] eight and twenty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit, one measure [is] to all the curtains;
texts.exo.26.3: five of the curtains are joining one unto another, and five curtains are joining one to another.
texts.exo.26.4: `And thou hast made loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain, at the end in the joining; and so thou makest in the edge of the outermost curtain, in the joining of the second.
texts.exo.26.5: fifty loops thou dost make in the one curtain, and fifty loops thou dost make in the edge of the curtain which [is] in the joining of the second, causing the loops to take hold one unto another;
texts.exo.26.6: and thou hast made fifty hooks of gold, and hast joined the curtains one to another by the hooks, and the tabernacle hath been one.
texts.exo.26.7: `And thou hast made curtains of goats' [hair], for a tent over the tabernacle; thou dost make eleven curtains:
texts.exo.26.8: the length of the one curtain [is] thirty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit; one measure [is] to the eleven curtains;
texts.exo.26.9: and thou hast joined the five curtains apart, and the six curtains apart, and hast doubled the six curtains over-against the front of the tent.
texts.exo.26.10: `And thou hast made fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain, the outermost in the joining, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is joining the second;
texts.exo.26.11: and thou hast made fifty hooks of brass, and hast brought in the hooks into the loops, and hast joined the tent, and it hath been one.
texts.exo.26.12: `And the superfluity in the curtains of the tent -- the half of the curtain which is superfluous -- hath spread over the hinder part of the tabernacle;
texts.exo.26.13: and the cubit on this side, and the cubit on that, in the superfluity in the length of the curtains of the tent, is spread out over the sides of the tabernacle, on this and on that, to cover it;
texts.exo.26.14: and thou hast made a covering for the tent, of rams' skins made red, and a covering of badgers' skins above.
texts.exo.26.15: `And thou hast made the boards for the tabernacle, of shittim wood, standing up;
texts.exo.26.16: ten cubits [is] the length of the board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of the one board;
texts.exo.26.17: two handles [are] to the one board, joined one unto another; so thou dost make for all the boards of the tabernacle;
texts.exo.26.18: and thou hast made the boards of the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;
texts.exo.26.19: and forty sockets of silver thou dost make under the twenty boards, two sockets under the one board for its two handles, and two sockets under the other board for its two handles.
texts.exo.26.20: `And for the second side of the tabernacle, for the north side, [are] twenty boards,
texts.exo.26.21: and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under another board.
texts.exo.26.22: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward, thou dost make six boards.
texts.exo.26.23: And two boards thou dost make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
texts.exo.26.24: And they are pairs beneath, and together they are pairs above its head unto the one ring; so is it for them both, they are for the two corners.
texts.exo.26.25: And they have been eight boards, and their sockets of silver [are] sixteen sockets, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under another board.
texts.exo.26.26: `And thou hast made bars of shittim wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
texts.exo.26.27: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle at the two sides, westward;
texts.exo.26.28: and one hath caused the middle bar in the midst of the boards to reach from end unto end;
texts.exo.26.29: and the boards thou dost overlay [with] gold, and their rings thou dost make of gold places for bars, and hast overlaid their bars with gold;
texts.exo.26.30: and thou hast raised up the tabernacle according to its fashion which thou hast been shewn in the mount.
texts.exo.26.31: `And thou hast made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer; he maketh it [with] cherubs;
texts.exo.26.32: and thou hast put it on four pillars of shittim wood, overlaid [with] gold, their pegs [are] of gold, on four sockets of silver.
texts.exo.26.33: `And thou hast put the vail under the hooks, and hast brought in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony; and the vail hath made a separation for you between the holy and the holy of holies.
texts.exo.26.34: `And thou hast put the mercy-seat on the ark of the testimony, in the holy of holies.
texts.exo.26.35: `And thou hast set the table at the outside of the vail, and the candlestick over-against the table on the side of the tabernacle southward, and the table thou dost put on the north side.
texts.exo.26.36: `And thou hast made a covering for the opening of the tent, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer;
texts.exo.26.37: and thou hast made for the covering five pillars of shittim [wood], and hast overlaid them [with] gold, their pegs [are] of gold, and thou hast cast for them five sockets of brass.
texts.exo.27.1: `And thou hast made the altar of shittim wood, five cubits the length, and five cubits the breadth -- the altar is square -- and three cubits its height.
texts.exo.27.2: And thou hast made its horns on its four corners, its horns are of the same, and thou hast overlaid it [with] brass.
texts.exo.27.3: And thou hast made its pots to remove its ashes, and its shovels, and its bowls, and its forks, and its fire-pans, even all its vessels thou dost make of brass.
texts.exo.27.4: `And thou hast made for it a grate of net-work of brass, and hast made on the net four rings of brass on its four extremities,
texts.exo.27.5: and hast put it under the compass of the altar beneath, and the net hath been unto the middle of the altar.
texts.exo.27.6: `And thou hast made staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them [with] brass.
texts.exo.27.7: And the staves have been brought into the rings, and the staves have been on the two sides of the altar in bearing it.
texts.exo.27.8: Hollow with boards thou dost make it, as it hath been shewed thee in the mount, so do they make [it].
texts.exo.27.9: `And thou hast made the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward, hangings for the court of twined linen, a hundred by the cubit [is] the length for the one side,
texts.exo.27.10: and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets [are] of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets [are] of silver;
texts.exo.27.11: and so for the north side in length, hangings of a hundred [cubits] in length, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets [are] of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets [are] of silver.
texts.exo.27.12: `And [for] the breadth of the court at the west side [are] hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
texts.exo.27.13: And [for] the breadth of the court at the east side, eastward, [are] fifty cubits.
texts.exo.27.14: And the hangings at the side [are] fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three.
texts.exo.27.15: And at the second side [are] hangings fifteen [cubits], their pillars three, and their sockets three.
texts.exo.27.16: `And for the gate of the court a covering of twenty cubits, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer; their pillars four, their sockets four.
texts.exo.27.17: All the pillars of the court round about [are] filleted [with] silver, their pegs [are] silver, and their sockets brass.
texts.exo.27.18: `The length of the court [is] a hundred by the cubit, and the breadth fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of twined linen, and their sockets [are] brass,
texts.exo.27.19: even all the vessels of the tabernacle, in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, [are] brass.
texts.exo.27.20: `And thou -- thou dost command the sons of Israel, and they bring unto thee pure beaten olive oil for the light, to cause the lamp to go up continually;
texts.exo.27.21: in the tent of meeting, at the outside of the vail, which [is] over the testimony, doth Aaron -- his sons also -- arrange it from evening till morning before Jehovah -- a statute age-during to their generations, from the sons of Israel.
texts.exo.28.1: `And thou, bring thou near unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from the midst of the sons of Israel, for his being priest to Me, [even] Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron;
texts.exo.28.2: and thou hast made holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for honour and for beauty;
texts.exo.28.3: and thou -- thou dost speak unto all the wise of heart, whom I have filled [with] a spirit of wisdom, and they have made the garments of Aaron to sanctify him for his being priest to Me.
texts.exo.28.4: `And these [are] the garments which they make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and an upper robe, and an embroidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle; yea, they have made holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and for his sons, for his being priest to Me.
texts.exo.28.5: `And they take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the linen,
texts.exo.28.6: and have made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer;
texts.exo.28.7: it hath two shoulders joining at its two ends, and it is joined.
texts.exo.28.8: `And the girdle of his ephod which [is] on him, according to its work, is of the same, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
texts.exo.28.9: `And thou hast taken the two shoham stones, and hast opened on them the names of the sons of Israel;
texts.exo.28.10: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the second stone, according to their births;
texts.exo.28.11: the work of an engraver in stone, openings of a signet, thou dost open the two stones by the names of the sons of Israel; turned round, embroidered [with] gold, thou dost make them.
texts.exo.28.12: `And thou hast set the two stones on the shoulders of the ephod -- stones of memorial to the sons of Israel -- and Aaron hath borne their names before Jehovah, on his two shoulders, for a memorial.
texts.exo.28.13: `And thou hast made embroidered things of gold,
texts.exo.28.14: and two chains of pure gold, wreathed work thou dost make them, work of thick bands, and thou hast put the thick chains on the embroidered things.
texts.exo.28.15: `And thou hast made a breastplate of judgment, work of a designer; according to the work of the ephod thou dost make it; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen thou dost make it;
texts.exo.28.16: it is square, doubled, a span its length, and a span its breadth.
texts.exo.28.17: `And thou hast set in it settings of stone, four rows of stone; a row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle [is] the first row;
texts.exo.28.18: and the second row [is] emerald, sapphire, and diamond;
texts.exo.28.19: and the third row [is] opal, agate, and amethyst;
texts.exo.28.20: and the fourth row [is] beryl, and onyx, and jasper; embroidered with gold are they in their settings,
texts.exo.28.21: and the stones are according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, openings of a signet, each by his name are they for the twelve tribes.
texts.exo.28.22: `And thou hast made on the breastplate wreathed chains, work of thick bands, of pure gold;
texts.exo.28.23: and thou hast made on the breastplate two rings of gold, and hast put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate;
texts.exo.28.24: and thou hast put the two thick bands of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastplate;
texts.exo.28.25: and the two ends of the two thick bands thou dost put on the two embroidered things, and thou hast put [them] on the shoulders of the ephod over-against its face.
texts.exo.28.26: `And thou hast made two rings of gold, and hast set them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its border, which [is] over-against the ephod within;
texts.exo.28.27: and thou hast made two rings of gold, and hast put them on the two shoulders of the ephod, beneath, over-against its front, over-against its joining, above the girdle of the ephod,
texts.exo.28.28: and they bind the breastplate by its rings unto the rings of the ephod with a ribbon of blue, to be above the girdle of the ephod, and the breastplate is not loosed from the ephod.
texts.exo.28.29: `And Aaron hath borne the names of the sons of Israel in the breastplate of judgment, on his heart, in his going in unto the sanctuary, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.
texts.exo.28.30: `And thou hast put unto the breastplate of judgment the Lights and the Perfections, and they have been on the heart of Aaron, in his going in before Jehovah, and Aaron hath borne the judgment of the sons of Israel on his heart before Jehovah continually.
texts.exo.28.31: `And thou hast made the upper robe of the ephod completely of blue,
texts.exo.28.32: and the opening for its head hath been in its midst, a border is to its opening round about, work of a weaver, as the opening of a habergeon there is to it; it is not rent.
texts.exo.28.33: `And thou hast made on its hem pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, on its hem round about, and bells of gold in their midst round about;
texts.exo.28.34: a bell of gold and a pomegranate, a bell of gold and a pomegranate [are] on the hems of the upper robe round about.
texts.exo.28.35: `And it hath been on Aaron to minister in, and its sound hath been heard in his coming in unto the sanctuary before Jehovah, and in his going out, and he doth not die.
texts.exo.28.36: `And thou hast made a flower of pure gold, and hast opened on it -- openings of a signet -- `Holy to Jehovah;'
texts.exo.28.37: and thou hast put it on a blue ribbon, and it hath been on the mitre -- over-against the front of the mitre it is;
texts.exo.28.38: and it hath been on the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron hath borne the iniquity of the holy things which the sons of Israel do hallow, even all their holy gifts; and it hath been on his forehead continually for a pleasing thing for them before Jehovah.
texts.exo.28.39: `And thou hast embroidered the coat of linen, and hast made a mitre of linen, and a girdle thou dost make -- work of an embroiderer.
texts.exo.28.40: `And for the sons of Aaron thou dost make coats, and thou hast made for them girdles, yea, bonnets thou dost make for them, for honour and for beauty;
texts.exo.28.41: and thou hast clothed Aaron thy brother with them, and his sons with him, and hast anointed them, and hast consecrated their hand, and hast sanctified them, and they have been priests to Me.
texts.exo.28.42: `And make thou for them linen trousers to cover the naked flesh: they are from the loins even unto the thighs;
texts.exo.28.43: and they have been on Aaron and on his sons, in their going in unto the tent of meeting, or in their drawing nigh unto the altar to minister in the sanctuary, and they do not bear iniquity nor have they died; a statute age-during to him, and to his seed after him.
texts.exo.29.1: `And this [is] the thing which thou dost to them, to hallow them, for being priests to Me: Take one bullock, a son of the herd, and two rams, perfect ones,
texts.exo.29.2: and bread unleavened, and cakes unleavened anointed with oil, of fine wheaten flour thou dost make them,
texts.exo.29.3: and thou hast put them on one basket, and hast brought them near in the basket, also the bullock and the two rams.
texts.exo.29.4: `And Aaron and his sons thou dost bring near unto the opening of the tent of meeting, and hast bathed them with water;
texts.exo.29.5: and thou hast taken the garments, and hast clothed Aaron with the coat, and the upper robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and hast girded him with the girdle of the ephod,
texts.exo.29.6: and hast set the mitre on his head, and hast put the holy crown on the mitre,
texts.exo.29.7: and hast taken the anointing oil, and hast poured [it] on his head, and hast anointed him.
texts.exo.29.8: `And his sons thou dost bring near, and hast clothed them [with] coats,
texts.exo.29.9: and hast girded them [with] a girdle (Aaron and his sons), and hast bound on them bonnets; and the priesthood hath been theirs by a statute age-during, and thou hast consecrated the hand of Aaron, and the hand of his sons,
texts.exo.29.10: and hast brought near the bullock before the tent of meeting, and Aaron hath laid -- his sons also -- their hands on the head of the bullock.
texts.exo.29.11: `And thou hast slaughtered the bullock before Jehovah, at the opening of the tent of meeting,
texts.exo.29.12: and hast taken of the blood of the bullock, and hast put [it] on the horns of the altar with thy finger, and all the blood thou dost pour out at the foundation of the altar;
texts.exo.29.13: and thou hast taken all the fat which is covering the inwards, and the redundance on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat which [is] on them, and hast made perfume on the altar;
texts.exo.29.14: and the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, thou dost burn with fire at the outside of the camp; it [is] a sin-offering.
texts.exo.29.15: `And the one ram thou dost take, and Aaron and his sons have laid their hands on the head of the ram,
texts.exo.29.16: and thou hast slaughtered the ram, and hast taken its blood, and hast sprinkled [it] on the altar round about,
texts.exo.29.17: and the ram thou dost cut into its pieces, and hast washed its inwards, and its legs, and hast put [them] on its pieces, and on its head;
texts.exo.29.18: and thou hast made perfume with the whole ram on the altar. It [is] a burnt-offering to Jehovah, a sweet fragrance; a fire-offering it [is] to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.19: `And thou hast taken the second ram, and Aaron hath laid -- his sons also -- their hands on the head of the ram,
texts.exo.29.20: and thou hast slaughtered the ram, and hast taken of its blood, and hast put on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot, and hast sprinkled the blood on the altar round about;
texts.exo.29.21: and thou hast taken of the blood which [is] on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and hast sprinkled on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him, and he hath been hallowed, he, and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
texts.exo.29.22: `And thou hast taken from the ram the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat which is covering the inwards, and the redundance on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat which [is] on them, and the right leg, for it [is] a ram of consecration,
texts.exo.29.23: and one round cake of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one thin cake out of the basket of the unleavened things which [is] before Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.24: `And thou hast set the whole on the hands of Aaron, and on the hands of his sons, and hast waved them -- a wave-offering before Jehovah;
texts.exo.29.25: and thou hast taken them out of their hand, and hast made perfume on the altar beside the burnt-offering, for sweet fragrance before Jehovah; a fire-offering it [is] to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.26: `And thou hast taken the breast from the ram of the consecration which [is] for Aaron, and hast waved it -- a wave-offering before Jehovah, and it hath become thy portion;
texts.exo.29.27: and thou hast sanctified the breast of the wave-offering, and the leg of the heave-offering, which hath been waved, and which hath been lifted up from the ram of the consecration, of that which [is] for Aaron, and of that which [is] for his sons;
texts.exo.29.28: and it hath been for Aaron and for his sons, by a statute age-during from the sons of Israel, for it [is] a heave-offering; and it is a heave offering from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace-offerings -- their heave-offering to Jehovah.
texts.exo.29.29: `And the holy garments which are Aaron's, are for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to consecrate in them their hand;
texts.exo.29.30: seven days doth the priest in his stead (of his sons) put them on, when he goeth in unto the tent of meeting, to minister in the sanctuary.
texts.exo.29.31: `And the ram of the consecration thou dost take, and hast boiled its flesh in the holy place;
texts.exo.29.32: and Aaron hath eaten -- his sons also -- the flesh of the ram, and the bread which [is] in the basket, at the opening of the tent of meeting;
texts.exo.29.33: and they have eaten those things by which there is atonement to consecrate their hand, to sanctify them; and a stranger doth not eat -- for they [are] holy;
texts.exo.29.34: and if there be left of the flesh of the consecration or of the bread till the morning, then thou hast burned that which is left with fire; it is not eaten, for it [is] holy.
texts.exo.29.35: `And thou hast done thus to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee; seven days thou dost consecrate their hand;
texts.exo.29.36: and a bullock, a sin-offering, thou dost prepare daily for the atonements, and thou hast atoned for the altar, in thy making atonement on it, and hast anointed it to sanctify it;
texts.exo.29.37: seven days thou dost make atonement for the altar, and hast sanctified it, and the altar hath been most holy; all that is coming against the altar is holy.
texts.exo.29.38: `And this [is] that which thou dost prepare on the altar; two lambs, sons of a year, daily continually;
texts.exo.29.39: the one lamb thou dost prepare in the morning, and the second lamb thou dost prepare between the evenings;
texts.exo.29.40: and a tenth [deal] of fine flour, mixed with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin, and a libation, a fourth part of a hin, of wine, [is] for the one lamb.
texts.exo.29.41: `And the second lamb thou dost prepare between the evenings; according to the present of the morning, and according to its libation, thou dost prepare for it, for sweet fragrance, a fire-offering, to Jehovah: --
texts.exo.29.42: a continual burnt-offering for your generations, at the opening of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah, whither I am met with you, to speak unto thee there,
texts.exo.29.43: and I have met there with the sons of Israel, and it hath been sanctified by My honour.
texts.exo.29.44: `And I have sanctified the tent of meeting, and the altar, and Aaron and his sons I sanctify for being priests to Me,
texts.exo.29.45: and I have tabernacled in the midst of the sons of Israel, and have become their God,
texts.exo.29.46: and they have known that I [am] Jehovah their God, who hath brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I may tabernacle in their midst; I [am] Jehovah their God.
texts.exo.30.1: `And thou hast made an altar [for] making perfume; [of] shittim wood thou dost make it;
texts.exo.30.2: a cubit its length, and a cubit its breadth, (it is square), and two cubits its height; its horns [are] of the same.
texts.exo.30.3: `And thou hast overlaid it with pure gold, its top, and its sides round about, and its horns; and thou hast made to it a crown of gold round about;
texts.exo.30.4: and two rings of gold thou dost make to it under its crown; on its two ribs thou dost make [them], on its two sides, and they have become places for staves, to bear it with them.
texts.exo.30.5: `And thou hast made the staves of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them with gold;
texts.exo.30.6: and thou hast put it before the vail, which [is] by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy-seat which [is] over the testimony, whither I am met with thee.
texts.exo.30.7: `And Aaron hath made perfume on it, perfume of spices, morning by morning; in his making the lamps right he doth perfume it,
texts.exo.30.8: and in Aaron's causing the lamps to go up between the evenings, he doth perfume it; a continual perfume before Jehovah to your generations.
texts.exo.30.9: `Ye do not cause strange perfume to go up upon it, and burnt-offering, and present, and libation ye do not pour out on it;
texts.exo.30.10: and Aaron hath made atonement on its horns, once in a year, by the blood of the sin-offering of atonements; once in a year doth he make atonement for it, to your generations; it [is] most holy to Jehovah.'
texts.exo.30.11: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.12: `When thou takest up the sum of the sons of Israel for their numbers, then they have given each an atonement [for] his soul to Jehovah in their being numbered, and there is no plague among them in their being numbered.
texts.exo.30.13: `This they do give, every one passing over unto those numbered, half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel [is] twenty gerahs); half a shekel [is] the heave-offering to Jehovah;
texts.exo.30.14: every one passing over unto those numbered, from a son of twenty years and upwards, doth give the heave-offering of Jehovah;
texts.exo.30.15: the rich doth not multiply, and the poor doth not diminish from the half-shekel, to give the heave-offering of Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.
texts.exo.30.16: `And thou hast taken the atonement-money from the sons of Israel, and hast given it for the service of the tent of meeting; and it hath been to the sons of Israel for a memorial before Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.'
texts.exo.30.17: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.18: `And thou hast made a laver of brass (and its base of brass), for washing; and thou hast put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and hast put water there;
texts.exo.30.19: and Aaron and his sons have washed at it their hands and their feet,
texts.exo.30.20: in their going in unto the tent of meeting they wash [with] water, and die not; or in their drawing nigh unto the altar to minister, to perfume a fire-offering to Jehovah,
texts.exo.30.21: then they have washed their hands and their feet, and they die not, and it hath been to them a statute age-during, to him and to his seed to their generations.'
texts.exo.30.22: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.exo.30.23: `And thou, take to thyself principal spices, wild honey five hundred [shekels]; and spice-cinnamon, the half of that, two hundred and fifty; and spice-cane two hundred and fifty;
texts.exo.30.24: and cassia five hundred, by the shekel of the sanctuary, and olive oil a hin;
texts.exo.30.25: and thou hast made it a holy anointing oil, a compound mixture, work of a compounder; it is a holy anointing oil.
texts.exo.30.26: `And thou hast anointed with it the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony,
texts.exo.30.27: and the table and all its vessels, and the candlestick and its vessels, and the altar of perfume,
texts.exo.30.28: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base;
texts.exo.30.29: and thou hast sanctified them, and they have been most holy; all that is coming against them is holy;
texts.exo.30.30: and Aaron and his sons thou dost anoint, and hast sanctified them for being priests to Me.
texts.exo.30.31: `And unto the sons of Israel thou dost speak, saying, A holy anointing oil is this to Me, to your generations;
texts.exo.30.32: on flesh of man it is not poured, and with its proper proportion ye make none like it; it [is] holy; it is holy to you;
texts.exo.30.33: a man who compoundeth [any] like it, or who putteth of it on a stranger -- hath even been cut off from his people.'
texts.exo.30.34: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Take to thee spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, spices and pure frankincense; they are part for part;
texts.exo.30.35: and thou hast made it a perfume, a compound, work of a compounder, salted, pure, holy;
texts.exo.30.36: and thou hast beaten [some] of it small, and hast put of it before the testimony, in the tent of meeting, whither I am met with thee; most holy it is to you.
texts.exo.30.37: `As to the perfume which thou makest, with its proper proportion ye do not make to yourselves, holy it is to thee to Jehovah;
texts.exo.30.38: a man who maketh [any] like it -- to be refreshed by it -- hath even been cut off from his people.'
texts.exo.31.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.exo.31.2: `See, I have called by name Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
texts.exo.31.3: and I fill him [with] the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,
texts.exo.31.4: to devise devices to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
texts.exo.31.5: and in graving of stone for settings, and in graving of wood to work in all work.
texts.exo.31.6: `And I, lo, I have given with him Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and in the heart of every wise-hearted one I have given wisdom, and they have made all that which I have commanded thee.
texts.exo.31.7: `The tent of meeting, and the ark of testimony, and the mercy-seat which [is] on it, and all the vessels of the tent,
texts.exo.31.8: and the table and its vessels, and the pure candlestick and all its vessels, and the altar of the perfume,
texts.exo.31.9: and the altar of the burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base,
texts.exo.31.10: and the coloured garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for acting as priests in;
texts.exo.31.11: and the anointing oil, and the perfume of the spices for the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded thee -- they do.'
texts.exo.31.12: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.exo.31.13: `And thou, speak unto the sons of Israel, saying, Only, My sabbaths ye do keep, for it [is] a sign between Me and you, to your generations, to know that I, Jehovah, am sanctifying you;
texts.exo.31.14: and ye have kept the sabbath, for it [is] holy to you, he who is polluting it is certainly put to death -- for any who doeth work in it -- that person hath even been cut off from the midst of his people.
texts.exo.31.15: `Six days is work done, and in the seventh day [is] a sabbath of holy rest to Jehovah; any who doeth work in the sabbath-day is certainly put to death,
texts.exo.31.16: and the sons of Israel have observed the sabbath; to keep the sabbath to their generations [is] a covenant age-during,
texts.exo.31.17: between Me and the sons of Israel it [is] a sign -- to the age; for six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, and in the seventh day He hath ceased, and is refreshed.'
texts.exo.31.18: And He giveth unto Moses, when He finisheth speaking with him in mount Sinai, two tables of the testimony, tables of stone, written by the finger of God.
texts.exo.32.1: And the people see that Moses is delaying to come down from the mount, and the people assemble against Aaron, and say unto him, `Rise, make for us gods who go before us, for this Moses -- the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt -- we have not known what hath happened to him.'
texts.exo.32.2: And Aaron saith unto them, `Break off the rings of gold which [are] in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring in unto me;'
texts.exo.32.3: and all the people themselves break off the rings of gold which [are] in their ears, and bring in unto Aaron,
texts.exo.32.4: and he receiveth from their hand, and doth fashion it with a graving tool, and doth make it a molten calf, and they say, `These thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.'
texts.exo.32.5: And Aaron seeth, and buildeth an altar before it, and Aaron calleth, and saith, `A festival to Jehovah -- to-morrow;'
texts.exo.32.6: and they rise early on the morrow, and cause burnt-offerings to ascend, and bring nigh peace-offerings; and the people sit down to eat and to drink, and rise up to play.
texts.exo.32.7: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Go, descend, for thy people whom thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt hath done corruptly,
texts.exo.32.8: they have turned aside hastily from the way that I have commanded them; they have made for themselves a molten calf, and bow themselves to it, and sacrifice to it, and say, These thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.'
texts.exo.32.9: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `I have seen this people, and lo, it [is] a stiff-necked people;
texts.exo.32.10: and now, let Me alone, and My anger doth burn against them, and I consume them, and I make thee become a great nation.'
texts.exo.32.11: And Moses appeaseth the face of Jehovah his God, and saith, `Why, O Jehovah, doth Thine anger burn against Thy people, whom Thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?
texts.exo.32.12: why do the Egyptians speak, saying, For evil He brought them out to slay them among mountains, and to consume them from off the face of the ground? turn back from the heat of Thine anger, and repent of the evil against Thy people.
texts.exo.32.13: `Be mindful of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, Thy servants, to whom Thou hast sworn by Thyself, and unto whom Thou speakest: I multiply your seed as stars of the heavens, and all this land, as I have said, I give to your seed, and they have inherited to the age;'
texts.exo.32.14: and Jehovah repenteth of the evil which He hath spoken of doing to His people.
texts.exo.32.15: And Moses turneth, and goeth down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony [are] in his hand, tables written on both their sides, on this and on that [are] they written;
texts.exo.32.16: and the tables are the work of God, and the writing is the writing of God, graven on the tables.
texts.exo.32.17: And Joshua heareth the voice of the people in their shouting, and saith unto Moses, `A noise of battle in the camp!'
texts.exo.32.18: and he saith, `It is not the voice of the crying of might, nor is it the voice of the crying of weakness -- a voice of singing I am hearing.'
texts.exo.32.19: And it cometh to pass, when he hath drawn near unto the camp, that he seeth the calf, and the dancing, and the anger of Moses burneth, and he casteth out of his hands the tables, and breaketh them under the mount;
texts.exo.32.20: and he taketh the calf which they have made, and burneth [it] with fire, and grindeth until [it is] small, and scattereth on the face of the waters, and causeth the sons of Israel to drink.
texts.exo.32.21: And Moses saith unto Aaron, `What hath this people done to thee, that thou hast brought in upon it a great sin?'
texts.exo.32.22: and Aaron saith, `Let not the anger of my lord burn; thou -- thou hast known the people that it [is] in evil;
texts.exo.32.23: and they say to me, Make for us gods, who go before us, for this Moses -- the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt -- we have not known what hath happened to him;
texts.exo.32.24: and I say to them, Whoso hath gold, let them break [it] off, and they give to me, and I cast it into the fire, and this calf cometh out.'
texts.exo.32.25: And Moses seeth the people that it [is] unbridled, for Aaron hath made it unbridled for contempt among its withstanders,
texts.exo.32.26: and Moses standeth in the gate of the camp, and saith, `Who [is] for Jehovah? -- unto me!' and all the sons of Levi are gathered unto him;
texts.exo.32.27: and he saith to them, `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Put each his sword by his thigh, pass over and turn back from gate to gate through the camp, and slay each his brother, and each his friend, and each his relation.'
texts.exo.32.28: And the sons of Levi do according to the word of Moses, and there fall of the people on that day about three thousand men,
texts.exo.32.29: and Moses saith, `Consecrate your hand to-day to Jehovah, for a man [is] against his son, and against his brother, so as to bring on you to-day a blessing.'
texts.exo.32.30: And it cometh to pass, on the morrow, that Moses saith unto the people, `Ye -- ye have sinned a great sin, and now I go up unto Jehovah, if so be I atone for your sin.'
texts.exo.32.31: And Moses turneth back unto Jehovah, and saith, `Oh this people hath sinned a great sin, that they make to themselves a god of gold;
texts.exo.32.32: and now, if Thou takest away their sin -- and if not -- blot me, I pray thee, out of Thy book which Thou hast written.'
texts.exo.32.33: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Whoso hath sinned against Me -- I blot him out of My book;
texts.exo.32.34: and now, go, lead the people whithersoever I have spoken to thee of; lo, My messenger goeth before thee, and in the day of my charging -- then I have charged upon them their sin.'
texts.exo.32.35: And Jehovah plagueth the people, because they made the calf which Aaron made.
texts.exo.33.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, `Go, ascend from this [place], thou and the people, whom thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I have sworn to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To thy seed I give it,'
texts.exo.33.2: (and I have sent before thee a messenger, and have cast out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,)
texts.exo.33.3: unto a land flowing with milk and honey, for I do not go up in thy midst, for thou [art] a stiff-necked people -- lest I consume thee in the way.'
texts.exo.33.4: And the people hear this sad thing, and mourn; and none put his ornaments on him.
texts.exo.33.5: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Say unto the sons of Israel, Ye [are] a stiff-necked people; one moment -- I come up into thy midst, and have consumed thee; and now, put down thine ornaments from off thee, and I know what I do to thee;'
texts.exo.33.6: and the sons of Israel take off their ornaments at mount Horeb.
texts.exo.33.7: And Moses taketh the tent, and hath stretched it out at the outside of the camp, afar off from the camp, and hath called it, `Tent of Meeting;' and it hath come to pass, every one seeking Jehovah goeth out unto the tent of meeting, which [is] at the outside of the camp.
texts.exo.33.8: And it hath come to pass, at the going out of Moses unto the tent, all the people rise, and have stood, each at the opening of his tent, and have looked expectingly after Moses, until his going into the tent.
texts.exo.33.9: And it hath come to pass, at the going in of Moses to the tent, the pillar of the cloud cometh down, and hath stood at the opening of the tent, and He hath spoken with Moses;
texts.exo.33.10: and all the people have seen the pillar of the cloud standing at the opening of the tent, and all the people have risen and bowed themselves, each at the opening of his tent.
texts.exo.33.11: And Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses face unto face, as a man speaketh unto his friend; and he hath turned back unto the camp, and his minister Joshua, son of Nun, a youth, departeth not out of the tent.
texts.exo.33.12: And Moses saith unto Jehovah, `See, Thou art saying unto me, Bring up this people, and Thou hast not caused me to know whom Thou dost send with me; and Thou hast said, I have known thee by name, and also thou hast found grace in Mine eyes.
texts.exo.33.13: `And now, if, I pray Thee, I have found grace in Thine eyes, cause me to know, I pray Thee, Thy way, and I know Thee, so that I find grace in Thine eyes, and consider that this nation [is] Thy people;'
texts.exo.33.14: and He saith, `My presence doth go, and I have given rest to thee.'
texts.exo.33.15: And he saith unto Him, `If Thy presence is not going -- take us not up from this [place];
texts.exo.33.16: and in what is it known now, that I have found grace in Thine eyes -- I and Thy people -- is it not in Thy going with us? and we have been distinguished -- I and Thy people -- from all the people who [are] on the face of the ground.'
texts.exo.33.17: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Even this thing which thou hast spoken I do; for thou hast found grace in Mine eyes, and I know thee by name.'
texts.exo.33.18: And he saith, `Shew me, I pray Thee, Thine honour;'
texts.exo.33.19: and He saith, `I cause all My goodness to pass before thy face, and have called concerning the Name of Jehovah before thee, and favoured him whom I favour, and loved him whom I love.'
texts.exo.33.20: He saith also, `Thou art unable to see My face, for man doth not see Me, and live;'
texts.exo.33.21: Jehovah also saith, `Lo, a place [is] by Me, and thou hast stood on the rock,
texts.exo.33.22: and it hath come to pass, in the passing by of Mine honour, that I have set thee in a cleft of the rock, and spread out My hands over thee, until My passing by,
texts.exo.33.23: and I have turned aside My hands, and thou hast seen My back parts, and My face is not seen.'
texts.exo.34.1: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Hew for thyself two tables of stone like the first, and I have written on the tables the words which were on the first tables which thou hast broken;
texts.exo.34.2: and be prepared at morning, and thou hast come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and hast stood before Me there, on the top of the mount,
texts.exo.34.3: and no man cometh up with thee, and also no man is seen in all the mount, also the flock and the herd do not feed over-against that mount.'
texts.exo.34.4: And he heweth two tables of stone like the first, and Moses riseth early in the morning, and goeth up unto mount Sinai, as Jehovah commanded him, and he taketh in his hand two tables of stone.
texts.exo.34.5: And Jehovah cometh down in a cloud, and stationeth Himself with him there, and calleth in the Name of Jehovah,
texts.exo.34.6: and Jehovah passeth over before his face, and calleth: `Jehovah, Jehovah God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in kindness and truth,
texts.exo.34.7: keeping kindness for thousands, taking away iniquity, and transgression, and sin, and not entirely acquitting, charging iniquity of fathers on children, and on children's children, on a third [generation], and on a fourth.'
texts.exo.34.8: And Moses hasteth, and boweth to the earth, and doth obeisance,
texts.exo.34.9: and saith, `If, I pray Thee, I have found grace in Thine eyes, O my Lord, let my Lord, I pray Thee, go in our midst (for it [is] a stiff-necked people), and thou hast forgiven our iniquity and our sin, and hast inherited us.'
texts.exo.34.10: And He saith, `Lo, I am making a covenant: before all thy people I do wonders, which have not been done in all the earth, or in any nation, and all the people in whose midst thou [art] have seen the work of Jehovah, for it [is] fearful that which I am doing with thee.
texts.exo.34.11: `Observe for thyself that which I am commanding thee to-day: lo, I am casting out from before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite;
texts.exo.34.12: take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land into which thou art going, lest it become a snare in thy midst;
texts.exo.34.13: for their altars ye break down, and their standing pillars ye shiver, and its shrines ye cut down;
texts.exo.34.14: for ye do not bow yourselves to another god -- for Jehovah, whose name [is] Zealous, is a zealous God.
texts.exo.34.15: `Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land, and they have gone a-whoring after their gods, and have sacrificed to their gods, and [one] hath called to thee, and thou hast eaten of his sacrifice,
texts.exo.34.16: and thou hast taken of their daughters to thy sons, and their daughters have gone a-whoring after their gods, and have caused thy sons to go a-whoring after their gods;
texts.exo.34.17: a molten god thou dost not make to thyself.
texts.exo.34.18: `The feast of unleavened things thou dost keep; seven days thou dost eat unleavened things, as I have commanded thee, at an appointed time, the month of Abib: for in the month of Abib thou didst come out from Egypt.
texts.exo.34.19: `All opening a womb [are] Mine, and every firstling of thy cattle born a male, ox or sheep;
texts.exo.34.20: and the firstling of an ass thou dost ransom with a lamb; and if thou dost not ransom, then thou hast beheaded it; every first-born of thy sons thou dost ransom, and they do not appear before Me empty.
texts.exo.34.21: `Six days thou dost work, and on the seventh day thou dost rest; in ploughing-time and in harvest thou dost rest.
texts.exo.34.22: `And a feast of weeks thou dost observe for thyself; first-fruits of wheat-harvest; and the feast of in-gathering, at the revolution of the year.
texts.exo.34.23: `Three times in a year do all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, God of Israel;
texts.exo.34.24: for I dispossess nations from before thee, and have enlarged thy border, and no man doth desire thy land in thy going up to appear before Jehovah thy God three times in a year.
texts.exo.34.25: `Thou dost not slaughter with a fermented thing the blood of My sacrifice; and the sacrifice of the feast of the passover doth not remain till morning:
texts.exo.34.26: the first of the first-fruits of the land thou dost bring into the house of Jehovah thy God; thou dost not boil a kid in its mother's milk.'
texts.exo.34.27: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Write for thyself these words, for, according to the tenor of these words I have made with thee a covenant, and with Israel.'
texts.exo.34.28: And he is there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; bread he hath not eaten, and water he hath not drunk; and he writeth on the tables the matters of the covenant -- the ten matters.
texts.exo.34.29: And it cometh to pass, when Moses is coming down from mount Sinai (and the two tables of the testimony [are] in the hand of Moses in his coming down from the mount), that Moses hath not known that the skin of his face hath shone in His speaking with him,
texts.exo.34.30: and Aaron seeth -- all the sons of Israel also -- Moses, and lo, the skin of his face hath shone, and they are afraid of coming nigh unto him.
texts.exo.34.31: And Moses calleth unto them, and Aaron and all the princes in the company return unto him, and Moses speaketh unto them;
texts.exo.34.32: and afterwards have all the sons of Israel come nigh, and he chargeth them with all that Jehovah hath spoken with him in mount Sinai.
texts.exo.34.33: And Moses finisheth speaking with them, and putteth on his face a vail;
texts.exo.34.34: and in the going in of Moses before Jehovah to speak with Him, he turneth aside the vail until his coming out; and he hath come out and hath spoken unto the sons of Israel that which he is commanded;
texts.exo.34.35: and the sons of Israel have seen the face of Moses that the skin of the face of Moses hath shone, and Moses hath put back the vail on his face until his going in to speak with Him.
texts.exo.35.1: And Moses assembleth all the company of the sons of Israel, and saith unto them, `These [are] the things which Jehovah hath commanded -- to do them:
texts.exo.35.2: Six days is work done, and on the seventh day there is to you a holy [day], a sabbath of rest to Jehovah; any who doeth work in it is put to death;
texts.exo.35.3: ye do not burn a fire in any of your dwellings on the sabbath-day.'
texts.exo.35.4: And Moses speaketh unto all the company of the sons of Israel, saying, `This [is] the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,
texts.exo.35.5: Take ye from among you a heave-offering to Jehovah; every one whose heart [is] willing doth bring it, -- the heave-offering of Jehovah, -- gold, and silver, and brass,
texts.exo.35.6: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' [hair],
texts.exo.35.7: and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
texts.exo.35.8: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the spice perfume,
texts.exo.35.9: and shoham stones, and stones for settings, for an ephod, and for a breastplate.
texts.exo.35.10: `And all the wise-hearted among you come in, and make all that Jehovah hath commanded:
texts.exo.35.11: `The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its hooks, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets,
texts.exo.35.12: `The ark and its staves, the mercy-seat, and the vail of the covering,
texts.exo.35.13: `The table and its staves, and all its vessels, and the bread of the presence,
texts.exo.35.14: `And the candlestick for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light,
texts.exo.35.15: `And the altar of perfume, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the spice perfume, and the covering of the opening at the opening of the tabernacle,
texts.exo.35.16: `The altar of burnt-offering and the brazen grate which it hath, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,
texts.exo.35.17: `The hangings of the court, its pillars, and their sockets, and the covering of the gate of the court,
texts.exo.35.18: `The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
texts.exo.35.19: `The coloured garments, to do service in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons to act as priest in.'
texts.exo.35.20: And all the company of the sons of Israel go out from the presence of Moses,
texts.exo.35.21: and they come in -- every man whom his heart hath lifted up, and every one whom his spirit hath made willing -- they have brought in the heave-offering of Jehovah for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
texts.exo.35.22: And they come in -- the men with the women -- every willing-hearted one -- they have brought in nose-ring, and ear-ring, and seal-ring, and necklace, all golden goods, even every one who hath waved a wave-offering of gold to Jehovah.
texts.exo.35.23: And every man with whom hath been found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' [hair], and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, have brought [them] in;
texts.exo.35.24: every one lifting up a heave-offering of silver and brass have brought in the heave-offering of Jehovah; and every one with whom hath been found shittim wood for any work of the service brought [it] in.
texts.exo.35.25: And every wise-hearted woman hath spun with her hands, and they bring in yarn, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the linen;
texts.exo.35.26: and all the women whose heart hath lifted them up in wisdom, have spun the goats' [hair].
texts.exo.35.27: And the princes have brought in the shoham stones, and the stones for settings, for the ephod, and for the breastplate,
texts.exo.35.28: and the spices, and the oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the spice perfume;
texts.exo.35.29: every man and woman (whom their heart hath made willing to bring in for all the work which Jehovah commanded to be done by the hand of Moses) [of] the sons of Israel brought in a willing-offering to Jehovah.
texts.exo.35.30: And Moses saith unto the sons of Israel, `See, Jehovah hath called by name Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
texts.exo.35.31: and He doth fill him [with] the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,
texts.exo.35.32: even to devise devices to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
texts.exo.35.33: and in graving of stones for settings, and in graving of wood to work in any work of design.
texts.exo.35.34: `And to direct He hath put in his heart, he and Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan;
texts.exo.35.35: He hath filled them with wisdom of heart to do every work, of engraver, and designer, and embroiderer (in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in linen), and weaver, who do any work, and of designers of designs.
texts.exo.36.1: And Bezaleel, and Aholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whom Jehovah hath given wisdom and understanding to know to do every work of the service of the sanctuary, have done according to all that Jehovah commanded.
texts.exo.36.2: And Moses calleth unto Bezaleel, and unto Aholiab, and unto every wise-hearted man in whose heart Jehovah hath given wisdom, every one whom his heart lifted up, to come near unto the work to do it.
texts.exo.36.3: And they take from before Moses all the heave-offering which the sons of Israel have brought in for the work of the service of the sanctuary to do it; and still they have brought in unto him a willing-offering morning by morning.
texts.exo.36.4: And all the wise men, who are doing all the work of the sanctuary, come each from his work which they are doing,
texts.exo.36.5: and speak unto Moses, saying, `The people are multiplying to bring in more than sufficient for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.'
texts.exo.36.6: And Moses commandeth, and they cause a voice to pass over through the camp, saying, `Let not man or woman make any more work for the heave-offering of the sanctuary;' and the people are restrained from bringing,
texts.exo.36.7: and the work hath been sufficient for them, for all the work, to do it, and to leave.
texts.exo.36.8: And all the wise-hearted ones among the doers of the work make the tabernacle; ten curtains of twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, [with] cherubs, work of a designer, he hath made them.
texts.exo.36.9: The length of the one curtain [is] eight and twenty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit; one measure [is] to all the curtains.
texts.exo.36.10: And he joineth the five curtains one unto another, and the [other] five curtains he hath joined one unto another;
texts.exo.36.11: and he maketh loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain, at the end, in the joining; so he hath made in the edge of the outmost curtain, in the joining of the second;
texts.exo.36.12: fifty loops he hath made in the one curtain, and fifty loops hath he made in the end of the curtain which [is] in the joining of the second; the loops are taking hold one on another.
texts.exo.36.13: And he maketh fifty hooks of gold, and joineth the curtains one unto another by the hooks, and the tabernacle is one.
texts.exo.36.14: And he maketh curtains of goats' [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he hath made them;
texts.exo.36.15: the length of the one curtain [is] thirty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain [is] four cubits; one measure [is] to the eleven curtains;
texts.exo.36.16: and he joineth the five curtains apart, and the six curtains apart.
texts.exo.36.17: And he maketh fifty loops on the outer edge of the curtain, in the joining; and fifty loops he hath made on the edge of the curtain which is joining the second;
texts.exo.36.18: and he maketh fifty hooks of brass to join the tent -- to be one;
texts.exo.36.19: and he maketh a covering for the tent of rams' skins made red, and a covering of badgers' skins above.
texts.exo.36.20: And he maketh the boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up;
texts.exo.36.21: ten cubits [is] the length of the [one] board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of the [one] board;
texts.exo.36.22: two handles [are] to the one board, joined one unto another; so he hath made for all the boards of the tabernacle.
texts.exo.36.23: And he maketh the boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward;
texts.exo.36.24: and forty sockets of silver he hath made under the twenty boards, two sockets under the one board for its two handles, and two sockets under the other board for its two handles.
texts.exo.36.25: And for the second side of the tabernacle, for the north side, he hath made twenty boards,
texts.exo.36.26: and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under the other board;
texts.exo.36.27: and for the sides of the tabernacle, westward, hath he made six boards;
texts.exo.36.28: and two boards hath he made for the corners of the tabernacle, in the two sides;
texts.exo.36.29: and they have been twins below, and together they are twins at its head, at the one ring; so he hath done to both of them at the two corners;
texts.exo.36.30: and there have been eight boards; and their sockets of silver [are] sixteen sockets, two sockets under the one board.
texts.exo.36.31: And he maketh bars of shittim wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
texts.exo.36.32: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle, for the sides westward;
texts.exo.36.33: and he maketh the middle bar to enter into the midst of the boards from end to end;
texts.exo.36.34: and the boards he hath overlaid with gold, and their rings he hath made of gold, places for bars, and he overlayeth the bars with gold.
texts.exo.36.35: And he maketh the vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer he hath made it, [with] cherubs;
texts.exo.36.36: and he maketh for it four pillars of shittim [wood], and overlayeth them with gold; their pegs [are] of gold; and he casteth for them four sockets of silver.
texts.exo.36.37: And he maketh a covering for the opening of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer,
texts.exo.36.38: also its five pillars, and their pegs; and he overlaid their tops and their fillets [with] gold, and their five sockets [are] brass.
texts.exo.37.1: And Bezaleel maketh the ark of shittim wood, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height;
texts.exo.37.2: and he overlayeth it with pure gold within and without, and maketh for it a wreath of gold round about;
texts.exo.37.3: and he casteth for it four rings of gold, on its four feet, even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its second side;
texts.exo.37.4: and he maketh staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold,
texts.exo.37.5: and he bringeth in the staves into the rings, by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
texts.exo.37.6: And he maketh a mercy-seat of pure gold, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth;
texts.exo.37.7: and he maketh two cherubs of gold, of beaten work he hath made them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
texts.exo.37.8: one cherub at the end on this [side], and one cherub at the end on that, out of the mercy-seat he hath made the cherubs, at its two ends;
texts.exo.37.9: and the cherubs are spreading out wings on high, covering over the mercy-seat with their wings, and their faces [are] one towards another; towards the mercy-seat have the faces of the cherubs been.
texts.exo.37.10: And he maketh the table of shittim wood; two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height,
texts.exo.37.11: and overlayeth it with pure gold, and maketh for it a wreath of gold round about.
texts.exo.37.12: And he maketh for it a border of a handbreadth round about, and maketh a wreath of gold for its border round about;
texts.exo.37.13: and he casteth for it four rings of gold, and putteth the rings on the four corners which [are] to its four feet;
texts.exo.37.14: over-against the border have the rings been, places for staves to bear the table.
texts.exo.37.15: And he maketh the staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold, to bear the table;
texts.exo.37.16: and he maketh the vessels which [are] upon the table, its dishes, and its bowls, and its cups, and the cups by which they pour out, of pure gold.
texts.exo.37.17: And he maketh the candlestick of pure gold; of beaten work he hath made the candlestick, its base, and its branch, its calyxes, its knops, and its flowers, have been of the same;
texts.exo.37.18: and six branches are coming out of its sides, three branches of the candlestick out of its one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of its second side;
texts.exo.37.19: three calyxes, made like almonds, in the one branch, a knop and a flower; and three calyxes, made like almonds, in another branch, a knop and a flower; so to the six branches which are coming out of the candlestick.
texts.exo.37.20: And in the candlestick [are] four calyxes, made like almonds, its knops, and its flowers,
texts.exo.37.21: and a knop under the two branches of the same, and a knop under the two branches of the same, and a knop under the two branches of the same, [are] to the six branches which are coming out of it;
texts.exo.37.22: their knops and their branches have been of the same; all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
texts.exo.37.23: And he maketh its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, of pure gold;
texts.exo.37.24: of a talent of pure gold he hath made it, and all its vessels.
texts.exo.37.25: And he maketh the perfume-altar of shittim wood; a cubit its length, and a cubit its breadth (square), and two cubits its height; its horns have been of the same;
texts.exo.37.26: and he overlayeth it with pure gold, its top and its sides round about, and its horns; and he maketh for it a wreath of gold round about;
texts.exo.37.27: and two rings of gold he hath made for it under its wreath, at its two corners, at its two sides, for places for staves to bear it with them.
texts.exo.37.28: And he maketh the staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold;
texts.exo.37.29: and he maketh the holy anointing oil, and the pure spice-perfume -- work of a compounder.
texts.exo.38.1: And he maketh the altar of burnt-offering of shittim wood, five cubits its length, and five cubits its breadth (square), and three cubits its height;
texts.exo.38.2: and he maketh its horns on its four corners; its horns have been of the same; and he overlayeth it with brass;
texts.exo.38.3: and he maketh all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the sprinkling-pans, the forks, and the fire-pans; all its vessels he hath made of brass.
texts.exo.38.4: And he maketh for the altar a brazen grate of net-work, under its border beneath, unto its midst;
texts.exo.38.5: and he casteth four rings for the four ends of the brazen grate -- places for bars;
texts.exo.38.6: and he maketh the staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with brass;
texts.exo.38.7: and he bringeth in the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it with them; hollow [with] boards he made it.
texts.exo.38.8: And he maketh the laver of brass, and its base of brass, with the looking-glasses of the women assembling, who have assembled at the opening of the tent of meeting.
texts.exo.38.9: And he maketh the court; at the south side southward, the hangings of the court of twined linen, a hundred by the cubit,
texts.exo.38.10: their pillars [are] twenty, and their brazen sockets twenty, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets [are] silver;
texts.exo.38.11: and at the north side, a hundred by the cubit, their pillars [are] twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the pegs of the pillars and their fillets [are] silver;
texts.exo.38.12: and at the west side [are] hangings, fifty by the cubit; their pillars [are] ten, and their sockets ten; the pegs of the pillars and their fillets [are] silver;
texts.exo.38.13: and at the east side eastward fifty cubits.
texts.exo.38.14: The hangings on the side [are] fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three,
texts.exo.38.15: and at the second side at the gate of the court, on this and on that, [are] hangings, fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three;
texts.exo.38.16: all the hangings of the court round about [are] of twined linen,
texts.exo.38.17: and the sockets for the pillars of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets of silver, and the overlaying of their tops of silver, and all the pillars of the court are filleted with silver.
texts.exo.38.18: And the covering of the gate of the court [is] the work of an embroiderer, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen; and twenty cubits [is] the length, and the height with the breadth five cubits, over-against the hangings of the court;
texts.exo.38.19: and their pillars [are] four, and their sockets of brass four, their pegs [are] of silver, and the overlaying of their tops and their fillets [are] of silver;
texts.exo.38.20: and all the pins for the tabernacle, and for the court round about, [are] of brass.
texts.exo.38.21: These are the numberings of the tabernacle (the tabernacle of testimony), which hath been numbered by the command of Moses, the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
texts.exo.38.22: And Bezaleel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, hath made all that Jehovah commanded Moses;
texts.exo.38.23: and with him [is] Aholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and designer, and embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in linen.
texts.exo.38.24: All the gold which is prepared for the work in all the work of the sanctuary (and it is the gold of the wave-offering) [is] twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary.
texts.exo.38.25: And the silver of those numbered of the company [is] a hundred talents, and a thousand and seven hundred and five and seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary;
texts.exo.38.26: a bekah for a poll (half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary,) for every one who is passing over unto those numbered, from a son of twenty years and upwards, for six hundred thousand, and three thousand, and five hundred and fifty.
texts.exo.38.27: And a hundred talents of silver are to cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; a hundred sockets for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket;
